Job Description:

Japan HR Services Team Leader (Remote role based in Dalian/Onsite role based in Shanghai, China)

3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

Role Overview

The HR Services Team Lead for Japan is a member of the Global HR Service Delivery Operations team and is accountable for the delivery of high-quality HR services for Japan.
This is a remote role based in Dalian, China, supporting HR service delivery for the Japan market.

This role provides leadership and direction for the Japan HR Services operation, ensuring consistent, compliant, and employee-centric service delivery through a combination of local and remote resources. The position serves as the primary point of accountability for HR Service Delivery in Japan, overseeing day-to-day operations while maintaining a hands-on role in service execution and issue resolution.

The HR Services Team Lead partners closely with local HR teams, regional HR Operations, Centers of Excellence (COEs), vendors, and global stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery, operational excellence, and business continuity. Beyond operational management, the role drives continuous improvement through process simplification, standardization, digitization, and automation initiatives that enhance both employee experience and operational efficiency.

The successful candidate will build strong stakeholder partnerships, foster trust and understanding of the HR Services model, and lead change initiatives that support the evolution of HR service delivery in Japan.

What Differentiates This Role

Unlike a traditional HR Operations role, this position will be based in Dalian, China but is accountable for the overall success of HR Services delivery in Japan. The role combines team leadership, operational accountability, service ownership, employee experience, and transformation leadership, with a strong emphasis on process simplification, automation, service optimization, and sustainable service delivery excellence.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As an HR Services Coordinator, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative and diverse people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:

HR Service Delivery Leadership & Team Management

  • Own overall HR Service Delivery performance for Japan, ensuring high-quality, consistent, and compliant services
  • Lead and coordinate a blended team of local and remote HR Services resources supporting Japan
  • Prioritize workloads, allocate resources, and ensure service continuity across all HR operational activities
  • Monitor service performance, identify risks and capacity challenges, and drive proactive resolution
  • Coach, support, and develop team members while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a service excellence mindset
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex employee, manager, and stakeholder issues

Service Delivery & Operations

  • Provide hands-on support for HR operations while ensuring effective execution across the wider team
  • Respond to employee and manager inquiries, ensuring timely and accurate resolution of HR-related requests
  • Oversee employee lifecycle administration, including hiring, termination, leave of absence (LOA), transfers, and return-from-leave processes
  • Manage document administration and coordination with employees, managers, vendors, and external authorities
  • Ensure accuracy and integrity of employee data maintained in Workday and other HR systems
  • Drive adherence to established service standards, controls, and compliance requirements
  • Manage relationships with external vendors, government agencies, and regulatory bodies
  • Ensure accurate preparation and issuance of employment-related certificates and documentation
  • Maintain compliance with local regulations, internal standards, and audit requirements

Benefits & Programs Administration

  • Oversee administration of pension programs (DB/DC), health insurance programs, and other country-specific HR processes
  • Oversee administration of employee benefit programs and related processes, including:
    • Company housing programs
    • Employee savings plans and group insurance
    • Relocation support and allowances
    • Various employee allowances and reimbursements
  • Ensure timely vendor coordination, payroll inputs, payments, reconciliations, and employee support
  • Drive process consistency and service quality across all benefits-related activities

Process Ownership & Operational Excellence

  • Act as the end-to-end process owner for HR Services delivery across Japan
  • Maintain visibility across all operational processes, identifying dependencies, bottlenecks, risks, and improvement opportunities
  • Drive alignment and coordination across local HR, regional HR Operations, COEs, Payroll, Finance, and external partners
  • Establish governance and operational discipline to ensure sustainable service delivery and workload management
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, knowledge repositories, and service standards

Continuous Improvement, Simplification & Automation

  • Lead initiatives to simplify, streamline, and modernize HR service delivery processes
  • Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities for increased efficiency, scalability, and quality
  • Drive adoption of automation, self-service solutions, digital tools, and workflow optimization
  • Partner with regional and global teams to standardize processes and implement best practices
  • Support implementation of new technologies, process enhancements, and service model changes
  • Utilize operational metrics and employee feedback to continuously improve outcomes

Employee Experience & Stakeholder Partnership

  • Champion a positive employee experience by ensuring responsive, reliable, and customer-focused HR support
  • Build strong partnerships with local HR teams, People Experience leaders, COEs, managers, and business stakeholders
  • Act as a trusted advisor on HR Services processes and operational matters
  • Drive awareness, understanding, and adoption of HR Services programs, tools, and processes
  • Lead change management efforts associated with service transformation and process improvements

Service Continuity & Risk Management

  • Ensure operational resilience through effective succession planning, cross-training, and knowledge management
  • Identify service delivery risks, resource constraints, and process vulnerabilities and implement mitigation plans
  • Lead business continuity planning to maintain stable service delivery during periods of organizational change, transition, or increased demand
  • Establish sustainable operating models that reduce dependency on individual contributors and improve long-term service stability

Reporting, Analytics & Performance Management

  • Monitor service performance using operational KPIs, service metrics, and employee feedback
  • Provide reporting and insights to local, regional, and global stakeholders
  • Identify trends and recommend actions to improve service quality, efficiency, and employee satisfaction
  • Support data-driven decision-making across HR Operations and partner functions

Your Skills and Expertise

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher

In addition to the above requirements, the following are also required:

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of HR Operations or Shared Services experience, preferably within a complex multinational environment
  • Strong knowledge of Japan HR practices, employment regulations, benefits, and employee lifecycle processes, with Shared Services Centre experience supporting the Japan market preferred
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with Japan-based stakeholders and navigate Japanese business and cultural practices
  • Experience leading teams or coordinating service delivery across multiple stakeholders and locations
  • Strong experience in benefits administration, employee lifecycle management, pension programs, health insurance administration, or related HR operations
  • Experience driving process improvement, standardization, digitization, or automation initiatives
  • Experience working within global or regional HR service delivery models​
  • Excellent Japanese language communication capabilities both oral and written.

Key Capabilities

  • Strong leadership and people management skills
  • End-to-end process ownership mindset
  • Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • Strong customer and employee experience orientation
  • Proven ability to lead change and drive adoption of new ways of working
  • Continuous improvement and operational excellence mindset
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to balance strategic priorities with hands-on operational execution
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and reporting tools
  • Understanding of local labor laws

Languages

  • Fluent Japanese and English (written and verbal)

Work location: Dalian, China/Shanghai, China

  • Remote or Hybrid working arrangement

Travel: as business required

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).

Supporting Your Well-being

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

raw.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a VP, Product Management. This position is remote-friendly; collaboration with engineering, UX, and PM teams in the U.S., Australia, Prague, and India is expected.

About Alteryx:

Alteryx is the business logic layer for the intelligent enterprise. More than 8,000 customers — including Bank of America, Coca-Cola, and Siemens — depend on us to turn data into decisions, and last year they processed 774 trillion records on our platform. We are a company of more than a billion dollars in revenue.

About The Role:

AI doesn’t know how your company runs finance operations. Neither does your data platform. The context that makes AI useful inside an enterprise — the business logic, the exceptions, the way this company actually does this work — lives in Alteryx workflows, across finance, retail, supply chain, and beyond.

That context is also what makes AI credible. Enterprises stall at the same wall every time: nobody can tell whether the answer is right, why it came out that way, or who is accountable if it isn’t. Analysis has to be trusted, understandable, and auditable before an organization will let it run the business, and the workflow is where that accountability lives.

We’re now embarking on the next phase of the story: reimagining the product for an AI-first era. Analysts should be able to describe a business problem and get it solved. Their analysis and their workflows should become the backbone of the agentic systems running inside their business.

We’re looking for a Vice President of Product Management to make that real. You’ll report to the Chief Product Officer as a core member of the product leadership team, with executive sponsorship for the mandate and the latitude to shape both the organization and the strategy around what you learn.

What This Role Is Not:

This is not a caretaker job for a mature product, and it is not a year of discovery. We have a point of view on where this is going, and we’re looking for someone who will make it sharper — not someone who needs to start from a blank page. You’ll reshape the central paradigm of a product that millions of hours of existing work depend on, while that business keeps performing. If you want a clean sheet, this isn’t it.

What Success Looks Like:

We know where we want to go. We need someone to get us there quickly, and to keep the destination honest as the ground shifts. In the first year that means movement on what product can actually move — evaluation win rate, activation, time-to-first-outcome, POC conversion — and shipped proof rather than slideware. In the second it shows up in new business and in expansion within existing customers. Throughout, the current business stays healthy while it is reshaped for an AI-first, data-platform-first future. This role suits someone who arrives with a high bar, gets to conviction fast, and is measured by what reaches customers.

What You’ll Do:

  • Sharpen the Vision and Land It:Bring the original thinking that keeps our direction right as the market moves, and convert it into a sequenced plan with real tradeoffs — one engineers want to build, sellers can sell, and customers recognize as true.

  • Hold the Bar on the Experience:Be accountable for what it feels like to use Alteryx — onboarding, first-run, and the everyday analyst workflow. Set the standard with Design, and hold it when schedules get tight.

  • Grow New and Existing Business: Own the product side of competitive evaluations — first-run, time-to-first-outcome, trial and POC success — and the expansion path that turns a first workflow into an enterprise footprint. Work with Sales, SE, and Marketing on why deals go the way they do, and close the gaps.

  • Own the Business:Act as the business owner for your portfolio: shape pricing and packaging, make the case for investment, and be accountable for the commercial outcome, not just the release.

  • Know the Market and the Customer:Develop first-hand understanding of the competitive field and where buyers are actually headed. Spend real time with prospects and non-customers, not just advocates.

  • Operate on Evidence:Instrument the product and define the metrics that matter. Build a culture where hypotheses get tested rather than debated.

  • Build the Team:Lead and mentor a team of Directors and Product Managers, developing both managers and senior individual contributors, with a culture of customer obsession, evidence, and pace.

  • Build the Coalition: Partner with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, SE, and CX to deliver a complete experience, not a set of features. Present to the ELT monthly and support quarterly board preparation.

You’re A Good Fit If You Have:

  • Led product management teams where the quality of the experience was the product’s advantage, and can say what you rejected to protect it.

  • Delivered results inside your first year in a senior role, in an organization that was already running.

  • Been accountable for a number and a transformation at the same time.

  • Shipped products that won competitive deals — you can point to new-logo growth or expansion you materially influenced.

  • Shipped and measured a production AI feature, and can describe what you evaluated and what you killed because it demoed well and failed in production.

  • Owned commercial outcomes for a portfolio — pricing, packaging, or the investment case.

  • Led as a leader of leaders, with credibility at executive level across functions.

You’ll Have An Edge If You Have:

  • Familiarity with the governance, lineage, and explainability expectations of regulated and data-mature enterprises.

  • Working knowledge of cloud data platforms and how they integrate into analytics workflows.

  • Experience leading globally distributed teams.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The salary range for this role in the United States is $275,000 - $325,000.

In addition, you may be eligible for additional compensation, such as a bonus. Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits, including medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

Interested? Learn more and apply today at alteryx.com/careers!

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity

The Project Manager will lead and coordinate mortgage-focused initiatives that support business growth, operational excellence, platform readiness, and successful execution across the organization. This role is responsible for bringing structure, accountability, and momentum to cross-functional projects while applying Agile practices where appropriate.

The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented project leader who can balance flexibility with disciplined delivery, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

What You'll Do

  • Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and success measures in partnership with stakeholders
  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals, technical feasibility, and organizational priorities
  • Provide clear, consistent, and timely project communication, including status updates, risks, issues, decisions, and executive-level reporting
  • Develop and maintain project plans, documentation, budgets, resource needs, and governance materials throughout the project lifecycle
  • Coordinate evaluation of process, technology, hardware, and software options, including cost-benefit considerations and implementation impacts
  • Identify, document, monitor, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies, and process control needs; escalate appropriately when impacts may affect delivery
  • Track project performance against short-term and long-term goals, using data and metrics to identify trends, drive accountability, and support informed decision-making
  • Lead mortgage-related projects using Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate for the initiative
  • Facilitate or assist in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, demos, backlog reviews, and prioritization discussions
  • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage backlogs, remove impediments, coordinate UAT, and support successful adoption
  • Work independently and collaboratively across multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Recommend improvements to project execution, team collaboration, process maturity, and operational effectiveness
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned based on business needs
  • Authorized Remote Locations: AL, AR, AZ, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MI, NC, SC, TX, UT
  • Salary Range: $90,000 - $111,000/yr (Exempt/Salaried)

What We Are Looking For:

  • 3 + years leading technical, non-technical, and enterprise projects in the mortgage industry
  • Working knowledge of Agile methodologies, delivery practices, ceremonies, and team collaboration models
  • Hands-on experience coordinating cross-functional workstreams, tracking deliverables, managing timelines, and communicating progress to stakeholders
  • Proficiency with project management software tools, methodologies, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of business operations, strategic planning, resource coordination, and process improvement principles
  • High School Diploma and/or GED equivalent
  • Ability to work effectively in both office and remote work environments while using standard office equipment, technology, and collaboration tools

What We Prefer to Find:

  • PMP, CSM, CSPO, SAFe, or similar project management or Agile certification
  • Experience with Agile delivery tools, backlog management tools, workflow management platforms, or project portfolio management systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field

Skills Desired:

  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to deliver clear project updates and communicate effectively with leaders at multiple levels
  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills, resourcefulness, and the ability to build effective working relationships
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging for different audiences
  • Skilled at influencing without authority, building alignment, and managing stakeholder expectations
  • Ability to adapt quickly to shifting priorities, changing timelines, and evolving organizational needs
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring project documentation, deliverables, and performance metrics meet quality standards
  • Ability to use data-driven insights to support informed decisions and recommend practical solutions
  • Strong understanding of dependencies, resource impacts, and long-term business outcomes
  • Ability to align project objectives with organizational strategy and measurable business outcomes
  • Ability to navigate cross-functional environments and communicate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to engage in oral and written communication
  • Must be able to reach, bend and lift files or paperwork up to 10 pounds
  • Must be able to work in an office environment to perform work
  • Must be able to use computer monitor and keyboard

raw.description:
About Spotted Zebra

At Spotted Zebra, we're building something we genuinely believe in: an AI-native end-to-end hiring platform that helps the world's leading organisations find the right people, faster and fairer than ever before. In short, we're making hiring something everyone loves again - both talent teams and candidates alike.

We're a multi-award-winning Series A company giving talent leaders the solution they've always needed. Skills science native. AI-amplified. Built by people who've lived and breathed TA and knew there had to be a better way.

What we do

Spotted Zebra brings Interview Intelligence, Skills Assessments, and AI Interview Agent together in one powerful platform, designed for intelligence and action. One powerful agent and assistant: Spot. Working the way talent teams need it to, always with humans in control.

The result is talent teams get the insight to predict who will succeed, the speed to move before competitors, the governance to defend every hiring decision, and the capacity to focus on the human moments that matter most.

But our product is only part of the story. Spotted Zebra isn’t just building an AI-native product; we’re building an AI-native company. AI is changing how we build, sell, support customers and make decisions. We use it to move faster, stay closer to customers, reduce unnecessary processes, and give talented people more leverage in their roles.

That means joining Spotted Zebra isn’t just a chance to work on the future of hiring. It’s a chance to help shape what the future of work looks like inside a scaling company: compact, ambitious teams using AI to collaborate better, make decisions quickly, and deliver meaningful impact at speed.

The FTSE100 and Fortune500 companies trusting us include British Airways, NIQ, Domino's, Lidl, Merlin Entertainments, AWE, United Utilities, and Paramount. We've been named Personnel Today's Talent Acquisition Supplier of the Year 2025, secured gold across multiple industry awards, and were recently named on the UK Top 100 Startups List.

But what we’re most proud of is the team. People join Spotted Zebra because the mission is real, the product is genuinely exciting, and the opportunity to shape the future of hiring is huge. What makes it special is the way we work: smart, committed people in compact teams where trust is high, decisions happen quickly, and everyone has the chance to make a visible impact.

If that sounds like the kind of place you want to do your best work - read on.

Our Dazzle (That's Our Team!) 🦓

Fun fact: A group of zebras is called a dazzle – and ours truly is dazzling!

We create a culture in which our team thrives and gallops ahead.

As we roam free and empower our dazzle, we gallop ahead on the journey to achieving our goals. We understand this journey will pose challenges along the way, yet we brighten the trail with our positive mindset and encouragement of others. The dazzle continuously moves, gaining knowledge and skills so that we can graze new grounds.

About the role

As a Sales Development Representative at Spotted Zebra, you'll be the engine of our enterprise pipeline, opening doors into UK, EMEA and US-headquartered organisations with 5,000+ FTE. Working in close partnership with our Account Executives, you'll research target accounts, craft personalised multi-channel outreach, and book high-quality meetings with senior Talent Acquisition and HR leaders.

This isn't a spray-and-pray SDR role. Our buyers are senior TA leaders at large, complex organisations, and the outreach that wins their attention is researched, relevant and consultative. You'll use AI tools daily to research faster, personalise at scale, and spend more of your time on the conversations that matter.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and manage a pipeline of opportunities through outbound prospecting across email, phone and LinkedIn (using tools such as Sales Navigator), targeting enterprise accounts (5,000+ FTE)
  • Dig into your accounts' hiring plans, transformation programmes, skills initiatives and news triggers so every touchpoint is relevant and personalised to the prospect
  • Become an expert in the talent acquisition space, staying on top of industry trends, challenges and news so you can bring genuine insight to every conversation
  • Ensure every meeting you hand to the Account Executives is high quality and set up for success
  • Engage senior stakeholders (Heads of TA, Directors of TA, CPOs) in credible, value-led conversations about their hiring challenges
  • Maintain excellent CRM hygiene in HubSpot, keeping pipeline data accurate so forecasting and reporting can be trusted
  • Work with marketing to convert campaigns, events, and content engagement into booked meetings
  • Use AI tools to work smarter, from account research and message drafting to call preparation and follow-up
  • Share what's working: feed learnings from the front line back into our messaging, ICP, and go-to-market playbook

Requirements

You'll be a great fit if you have ✅

  • Experience in an outbound sales or recruitment role, ideally as an SDR in B2B SaaS, or a compelling track record that shows you can prospect fearlessly, persist, and win attention
  • Experience in a B2B SaaS startup or fast-scaling company
  • Excellent written and verbal communication
  • Genuine curiosity about prospects and their businesses - prioritises researched, relevant messaging over generic mass outreach
  • Strong organisational skills - juggling multiple sequences, follow-ups and stakeholder conversations at once, while keeping your pipeline accurate and up to date
  • Resilience and self-motivation: you treat a "no" as data, not defeat, and you manage your own pipeline with discipline
  • Comfort speaking with senior stakeholders and holding a credible conversation about hiring, talent, and skills
  • Enthusiasm for AI tools and a willingness to experiment with new ways of working
  • A team-first mindset: you celebrate others' wins, share what you learn, and want to grow with the company

Nice-to-Haves 🌟

  • Experience selling SaaS into HR, Talent Acquisition, or People teams
  • Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM and sales engagement tools

Benefits

🤝 Meaningful share options

🏥 Health insurance

💰 Enhanced pension

🍼 Nursery salary sacrifice scheme
🏖️ 25 days holiday (excluding bank holidays)
🏠 Remote-first
💻 Work from home budget
🧠 L&D budget
🦷 Dental cover
👀 Eye-care support
🏢 Co-working space budget
🧘 Wellbeing allowance
✈️ Travel insurance

🚗 Electric car scheme

Beyond our core benefits, you'll get access to the latest AI-powered tools and technologies, giving you everything you need to do your best work.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

At Spotted Zebra, we welcome people of all stripes. We are committed to providing equal opportunities and an inclusive and diverse culture.

We believe that each and every one of us possesses an extraordinary set of skills and abilities, waiting to be discovered, nurtured, and harnessed for the benefit of all.

We are a team. And no matter your race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability, we will empower you to unleash your superpower to help us create a world where everyone is able to utilise their unique blend of skills and abilities to contribute to the greater good.

Everyone is unique and we encourage you to let us know in your application, or share with your recruiter directly, if there is anything we can do to make your interview experience with us more comfortable and positive.

At Spotted Zebra, everyone is welcome. So even if you don't meet all the requirements, we would still love to hear from you. We are always keen to speak with people who are passionate about our mission.

🦓 Ready to gallop ahead with us? We're a team that moves fast, thinks big, and isn't afraid to challenge how things have always been done. If you're excited about using AI and skills science to transform how the world hires, apply now and a member of our dazzle will be in touch!

raw.description:
The strategic and execution-focused Global Benefits Manager leads the design, implementation, and optimization of our global benefits programs. As part of a forward-thinking People & Culture (P&C) team, ensuring our benefits offerings are competitive, compliant, and aligned with employee needs across all regions. This role is central to shaping how Sage supports the health, wellbeing, and overall employee experience of its global workforce. It partners closely with P&C, Finance, brokers, and business leaders to drive a modern, scalable, and data-driven global benefits strategy.

Your New Role:

Global Benefits Strategy & Design

  • Lead the design and evolution of Sage’s global benefits strategy across the US, UK, India, and APAC, including health, retirement, wellbeing, and leave programs

  • Establish global guiding principles and minimum standards while allowing for local market customization

  • Continuously assess market trends and employee needs to enhance program competitiveness and relevance

  • Drive harmonization and scalability of benefits offerings where appropriate

Benefits Program Management

  • Oversee end-to-end administration of global benefits programs, including annual renewals, enrollments, and ongoing operations

  • Partner with brokers and vendors to evaluate plan design, pricing, and service delivery performance

  • Identify and implement cost optimization opportunities while maintaining strong employee value

  • Ensure effective communication and employee understanding of benefits offerings

Compliance & Governance

  • Ensure all benefits programs comply with local regulations, tax requirements, and data privacy laws (including GDPR and regional equivalents)

  • Maintain governance frameworks for global benefits, including policies, documentation, and audit readiness

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, and external advisors on regulatory changes and risk mitigation

Analytics & Insights

  • Develop and maintain benefits dashboards and reporting to provide insights into utilization, cost trends, and program effectiveness

  • Conduct regular benchmarking using market data (e.g., Mercer, WTW) to ensure competitiveness

  • Analyze employee feedback and participation data to inform program enhancements

  • Support DEI-aligned benefits analysis to ensure equitable access and outcomes

Systems & Technology

  • Administer and optimize benefits modules within HRIS platforms, ensuring data accuracy and seamless employee experience

  • Support implementation and enhancement of global benefits technology solutions

  • Partner with People Technology teams to automate processes and improve reporting capabilities

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the global subject matter expert for benefits across P&C and the business

  • Manage relationships with global and regional brokers, insurers, and third-party vendors

  • Partner with Finance on benefits budgeting, forecasting, and cost modeling

  • Lead vendor negotiations and renewal strategies to drive value and performance

Can you be our next Global Benefits Manager?

Essential Skills:

  • Proven experience managing global benefits programs across multiple regions

  • Deep understanding of health, retirement, wellbeing, and leave program design

  • Strong knowledge of global benefits compliance and regulatory environments

  • Experience working with benefits brokers and vendors on plan design and renewals

  • Advanced analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Proficiency in HRIS platforms and benefits administration systems

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for diverse audiences

  • Ability to operate effectively in a global, remote environment

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with global benefits strategy development and harmonization efforts

  • Familiarity with benefits benchmarking tools (e.g., Mercer, Willis Towers Watson)

  • Exposure to global mobility and expatriate benefits is a plus

  • Experience supporting People Technology transformations

Qualifications:

  • CEBS (Certified Employee Benefit Specialist) or similar certification preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related field or equivalent experience

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

raw.title: Information Systems Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a highly technical Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support a U.
raw.description:
We are seeking a highly technical Information Systems Security Engineer (ISSE) to support a U.S. Navy program through the Risk Management Framework (RMF), Authority to Operate (ATO), system hardening, vulnerability remediation, and day-to-day security engineering activities.

This is a hands-on engineering position. The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly on Linux servers, virtualization infrastructure, network infrastructure, and security monitoring platforms to implement, troubleshoot, validate, and maintain security controls.

The successful candidate will work closely with system administrators, network engineers, and cybersecurity personnel to identify security gaps and implement practical technical solutions that satisfy Navy RMF/ATO requirements.

This position is not primarily focused on strategy, program planning, configuration management, or developing project/VM plans. The focus is on technical execution and engineering.

Responsibilities

  • Perform hands-on security engineering in support of Navy RMF and ATO requirements.
  • Implement and validate technical security controls across servers, virtualization, network, and logging environments.
  • Harden systems in accordance with applicable DISA STIGs, Navy security requirements, and RMF control requirements.
  • Perform vulnerability remediation, including analysis of findings, root-cause identification, remediation, and validation.
  • Configure, secure, troubleshoot, and validate RHEL/Linux systems.
  • Support security hardening and troubleshooting of VMware environments.
  • Perform security configuration and troubleshooting of Cisco Catalyst and Cisco ACI infrastructure.
  • Support centralized security logging and monitoring using Splunk and Cribl.
  • Analyze system and security logs to troubleshoot issues and validate security requirements.
  • Support collection and validation of technical evidence required for RMF/ATO activities.
  • Translate RMF security requirements into practical technical implementations.
  • Work directly with infrastructure teams to remediate security deficiencies.
  • Automate repetitive security engineering and validation tasks where appropriate.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in cybersecurity, systems engineering, network engineering, or information assurance.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting RMF and ATO activities within a DoD environment.
  • Strong hands-on experience with RHEL/Linux administration and security hardening.
  • Experience implementing and validating DISA STIG requirements.
  • Hands-on experience with VMware environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Catalyst switching and Cisco ACI.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk and Cribl or comparable enterprise logging technologies.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability scanning, remediation, and security validation.
  • Strong Linux command-line and troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex infrastructure and security issues across operating-system, virtualization, network, and logging layers.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience supporting U.S. Navy or DoD mission systems.
  • Experience with Navy RMF processes and ATO assessments.
  • Experience with eMASS.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing DISA STIGs across multiple technology platforms.
  • Experience with Tenable/Nessus or comparable vulnerability-scanning platforms.
  • Experience with PowerShell, Bash, Python, or other scripting languages used for security automation.
  • Experience troubleshooting authentication, access control, auditing, encryption, and system logging requirements.
  • Experience integrating infrastructure logs into Splunk through Cribl.
  • Experience with SCAP/STIG compliance tooling.

Security Clearance

  • Active DoD Secret clearance required.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any additional program-specific access requirements.

Certifications

One or more of the following is preferred:

  • Security+
  • CISSP
  • CySA+
  • Linux-related certification
  • VMware certification
  • Cisco certification

Basic Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship Required

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The Inside Construction Loan Officer is responsible for converting inbound premium leads into loans by promoting CrossCountry Mortgage’s competitive mortgage products, services, and programs. This role consults with customers about their current and future goals to help achieve financing needs, collects and reviews all needed supporting loan documentation, and maintains minimum standards for production and quality.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Establish a presence for CCM, including but not limited to, converting incoming leads.

  • Analyze current rates and programs to provide accurate and timely information to borrowers.

  • Negotiate terms and conditions with borrowers.

  • Participate in all steps related to the origination of a mortgage loan including but not limited to, meeting with prospects, counseling borrowers, taking mortgage applications by phone.

  • Manage a personal pipeline to ensure service standards and financial goals are met.

raw.excerpt: About Bodwé Group Companies Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi.
raw.description:
About Bodwé Group Companies

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. We are architects, planners, consultants, designers, engineers, scientists, and federal contractors, committed to growing the economy and legacy of the Pokagon Band and supporting its more than 6,000 citizens. We provide value by integrating expertise across the natural and built environment lifecycle—from pre-development and planning to design, procurement, construction, and operations. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

Disclosure

This is a federal contracting opportunity that we, the Company, are bidding on and has not been awarded. The availability of this position is contingent upon successful award of the contract.

Position Summary

The Junior Analyst provides financial, programmatic, research, and technical-writing support to the Defense Health Agency Facilities Enterprise. The position supports Military Health System financial analysis, DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution activities, policy research, data consolidation, and the preparation of clear, decision-ready products for DHA leadership.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact .

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

  • Research Military Health System, DoD, and DHA policies, organizational structures, financial requirements, programs, and facility-related initiatives.
  • Collect, consolidate, review, and validate financial, program, policy, and stakeholder information from multiple sources.
  • Support PPBE-related planning, programming, budgeting, execution analysis, data calls, and leadership information requirements.
  • Analyze financial and program information to identify trends, inconsistencies, gaps, risks, and issues requiring further review.
  • Prepare and edit technical reports, executive summaries, information papers, memoranda, spreadsheets, presentations, trackers, and leadership updates.
  • Translate financial, policy, and program information into concise products understandable to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate inputs, comments, and supporting documentation from Government personnel, analysts, financial personnel, and technical subject-matter experts.
  • Maintain action trackers, suspense dates, document status, research files, meeting records, and required follow-up.
  • Support strategic-planning initiatives, business-process improvements, policy updates, special studies, and other DHA leadership priorities.
  • Perform quality-control reviews for data accuracy, completeness, consistency, formatting, and source documentation.
  • Anticipated work products may include financial analyses, PPBE research and support materials, spreadsheets, data summaries, technical reports, executive summaries, information papers, presentations, policy-support documents, action trackers, meeting materials, and leadership status updates.

Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

Required Education, Experience, and Technical Skills

  • A Bachelor’s degree in business management, accounting, finance, marketing, or operations management.
  • Five years of relevant experience in Military Health System (MHS) financial analysis, technical writing, or a related field.
  • Two years of experience with the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) system and familiarity with the structure of DoD and DHA.
  • Strong communications (written & verbal), analysis, research, and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize large amounts of information into concise leadership updates.
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport in order to undergo commercial airfare travel
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a valid driver's license

Required Professional Experience:

  • Five years of relevant experience in Military Health System (MHS) financial analysis, technical writing, or a related field.
  • Two years of experience with the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) system and familiarity with the structure of DoD and DHA.

Working Environment

This position operates in a professional office setting. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, and photocopiers. The work environment is generally quiet and free from exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery. Employees are typically seated for extended periods and may occasionally move about the office to attend meetings or access equipment and supplies.

Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This role is generally sedentary, performing sitting work utilizing technological office equipment, including a laptop, mouse, keyboard, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about inside the office to access the required technological equipment.

Stooping/Kneeling/Crouching/Crawling: This role may require stooping to reload printer trays with print paper, moving equipment, and managing cords.

Using Hands/Fingers:This role constantly operates technological office equipment such as laptops, mice, keyboards, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Talking/Hearing: This role requires constant communication with others in the organization to exchange information, review information, and make decisions about information.

Seeing: This role requires seeing, viewing, and distinguishing all aspects of internal and external communications.

Carrying/Lifting:This role requires lifting up to 20lbs to transport technological office equipment to and from various workspaces.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Bodwé Group Companies engage in federal contracting. Therefore, we would be thrilled to accept applications or referrals to hire veterans.

Native American Hiring Preference

Our parent company, Mno-Bmadsen, prefers to hire Pokagon citizens who are qualified and suitable for available positions. For purposes of this section, “qualified” means that the applicant meets the technical and experiential needs for employment; and “suitable” means that the candidate appears to be the best fit considering present circumstances and conditions. Targeted preference is in the following order:

  • First, to qualified Pokagon Band citizens; and
  • Second, to qualified spouses and qualified custodial parents; and
  • Third, to other qualified Native Americans; and
  • Fourth, to all other qualified applicants

Any determinations as to the applicability of the Pokagon hiring preference are at the discretion of each Company President.

Home Office Connectivity Requirements for Hybrid & Remote Positions

To ensure reliable collaboration, client service, and secure access to company systems, the Company requires minimum connectivity standards to be eligible or remain eligible to work in a hybrid or remote capacity. Employees working remotely must maintain broadband internet service capable of consistently supporting video conferencing, VPN connectivity, and cloud-based applications. Hybrid or remote work eligibility may be reassessed if connectivity standards are not met. This includes:

  • Wired broadband service (cable, fiber, or DSL) with at least minimum 100 Mbps download / 20 Mbps upload
  • Some positions may require minimum 200-300 Mbps download / 25-35 Mbps upload speed

Cellular hotspot or fixed wireless cellular services (e.g., T-Mobile Home Internet) may not be used as a primary connection. The Company will comply with all local, state, and federal requirements as it relates to the reimbursement of home internet expenses. Eligibility for reimbursement of home internet expenses is defined in a separate policy.

Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

The Brown & Brown/Risk Strategies National Pharmacy Team (NPT) is a team of 200+ teammates from across Brown & Brown, including pharmacists, client service representatives, actuaries, analysts, data engineers, developers, care team coordinators and more. The NPT brought together pharmacy specialist resources from many businesses across Brown & Brown organizing our teammates into three distinct teams:

    • Pharmacy Consulting and Analytics
    • Auditing
    • PillarRx Copay Maximization

Our relentless endeavor to obtain the best possible outcome for our clients comes from a belief that PBM contracts should be forthright and transparent. Inefficiencies and rising costs in the U.S. pharmacy industry have a direct impact on people and their health. It’s why plan sponsors strive to provide the best coverage for the best price. It’s also why we are committed to supporting them.

The Role

Brown & Brown is looking for a full-time Financial Analytics Manager to join their growing team. Brown & Brown is already an industry leader in prescription drug benefit savings and analytics. You will join a talented team of pharmacists, actuaries, data engineers and experienced pharmacy benefit client engagement managers. You will bring strong industry knowledge and will serve as a trusted business partner to your internal partners and Brown & Brown customers. A successful candidate is a team player who is creative, organized, detailed oriented, proactive and has strong experience in working in pharmacy benefit analytics.

The Financial Analytics Manager will work on all aspects of financial product and service delivery including RFP/procurement projects, renewals, market-check analysis, and financial analytics & reporting.

Essential Duties and Functions: include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Use proprietary financial analytic tools as well as excel to dive deeply into client pharmacy spend and underlying drivers of cost;
  • Assist with the development of methodologies, analytics, and outcomes assessments using output from our PharmaLogicTM system;
  • Manage all financial aspects of the internal RFP/procurement and market-check process for Brown & Brown clients which includes gathering and analyzing necessary incumbent data, financial evaluation and assessment of PBM RFP responses, working with online procurement tool, and the creation of summary reports, financial analysis and presentations.
  • Actively assist and support PBM contract reviews and PBM contract negotiations; including financial modeling and review of language
  • Assist with client presentations and reporting, including the evaluation of client utilization, trends and key findings within the pharmacy benefit;
  • Manage, mentor and train a team of financial analysts
  • Peer review of RFP evaluations
  • Manage all project timelines within the financial team to ensure timely completion
  • Work with other internal teams to strategize and improve system and process efficiencies
  • Assist with the training of all new employees on financial projects and financial evaluations

Competencies:

·Ability to work with financial models and to develop business logic behind them in excel

·Quick self-motivated learner who can initiate and drive new projects in anticipation of management and client goals and objectives

·Ability to work in cross-functionality, prioritize, and multi-task

·Superior critical thinking and analytic skills

·Ability to think strategically and proactively

·Ability to thrive in an environment with minimal oversight and lots of responsibility;

·Possesses a strong work ethic and takes ownership of client goals and objectives;

·Takes initiative and is self-directed;

·Strong teamwork skills, has the ability to encourage cooperation among team members;

·Excellent analytical and organizational skills;

·Planning/organizing—the individual prioritizes and plans work activities and uses time efficiently. Makes good and timely decisions that propels our company forward;

·Adaptability—the individual adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands and is able to deal with frequent change, delays or unexpected events.

Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Required

·Bachelor’s degree in business, finance and/or similar discipline with analytic base

·2-4 years’ experience in Pharmacy Benefit analytic consulting

·Strong experience in MS Office and/or MS Excel

Preferred

  • Knowledge of both Pharmacy and Medical data
  • Experience with Tableau or a similar business intelligence package
  • Experience in MS access or understanding of relational databases

$100,000 - $130,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

raw.title: HR Generalist
raw.excerpt: Why WarriorBabe?  At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth.
raw.description:
Why WarriorBabe?

At WarriorBabe, we believe in the power of dedication and personal growth. You'll be surrounded by a vibrant team that shares your passion for fitness and helping women flourish. Together, we are on a mission to transform lives and create a community that thrives on empowerment.

Offering personalized macronutrient plans and workout programming, WarriorBabe ensures each woman's unique needs are met. With one-on-one coaching, a dedicated mobile app, and a vibrant online community, WarriorBabe provides the tools and support necessary for lasting success. Ideal for women of all ages and fitness levels, WarriorBabe adapts to ensure continuous progress and achievement of fitness goals.

Our Mission

Help 100,000 women regain their personal power and feel confident in their skin.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced HR Generalist to support and take ownership of the day-to-day HR operations across WarriorBabe and our growing business lines.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who knows how to keep HR operations organized, accurate, and moving forward. You will be a primary point of contact for employees and leaders on day-to-day HR matters while supporting payroll, benefits, compliance, HR systems, documentation, and employee processes.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable working independently, has strong knowledge of multi-state employment compliance, understands payroll and HR administration, and can proactively identify and solve problems before they become bigger issues.

You won't simply be checking boxes — you'll be trusted to own your area, solve problems, and make sure things get done.

This role will partner closely with the Director of People and Chief People Officer. The broader People leadership team will continue to own strategy, organizational development, recruiting strategy, compensation, and complex escalations, while you will play a key role in the day-to-day execution and administration that keeps the People function running smoothly.

What You'll Own

HR Operations

  • Own day-to-day HR operations and employee support
  • Serve as a trusted resource for employees and managers on HR-related questions and processes
  • Manage employee changes including promotions, transfers, compensation changes, status changes, and other personnel updates
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records and documentation
  • Help develop, document, and improve HR processes and standard operating procedures
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve HR processes

Payroll

  • Own the end-to-end payroll process, ensuring accurate and timely payroll processing
  • Review payroll for accuracy, including wages, deductions, bonuses, commissions, PTO, employee changes, and other adjustments
  • Understand payroll tax requirements, liabilities, and multi-state payroll considerations
  • Partner with payroll providers and internal stakeholders to resolve payroll issues
  • Reconcile payroll and identify discrepancies before payroll is finalized
  • Maintain accurate payroll records and documentation
  • Monitor and respond to payroll-related tax notices and issues

Benefits & Leave Administration

  • Manage day-to-day benefits administration and employee support
  • Process benefit enrollments, changes, eligibility, and terminations
  • Partner with benefit providers and vendors to resolve issues
  • Administer PTO, leave, and other employee time-off programs
  • Maintain accurate benefit and leave records
  • Support annual benefits processes and open enrollment

Multi-State HR Compliance

  • Help maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, and local employment laws across multiple states
  • Monitor changes in employment regulations and flag potential impacts
  • Manage state registrations, employment notices, tax notices, and other compliance requirements
  • Maintain required employee and workplace documentation
  • Support audits and compliance reviews
  • Partner with leadership and external advisors when specialized legal guidance is needed
  • Proactively identify potential compliance concerns and bring them forward

HR Systems & Data

  • Manage day-to-day administration of the HRIS and related People systems
  • Ensure employee data, organizational information, compensation, job information, and employment records remain accurate
  • Manage system changes, workflows, permissions, and employee updates
  • Maintain People documentation, resources, and internal HR knowledge bases
  • Use HR data to identify trends, discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement

Onboarding & Offboarding Administration

  • Manage the administrative side of employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Ensure new hires are properly set up in HR, payroll, benefits, and applicable systems
  • Manage employment documentation and required forms
  • Coordinate employee changes and terminations across relevant systems and vendors
  • Ensure offboarding processes are completed accurately and on time

Workers' Compensation & Retirement

  • Manage day-to-day administration related to workers' compensation
  • Support workers' compensation claims, audits, renewals, and documentation
  • Manage administrative responsibilities related to the company's 401(k) plan
  • Coordinate with plan providers and vendors to resolve employee or administrative issues
  • Maintain accurate records and ensure required processes are completed on time

What We're Looking For

You are someone who takes ownership. You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done, and you don't need to be micromanaged to keep things moving.

We're looking for someone with:

  • 3-5+ years of progressive HR experience
  • Strong understanding of multi-state employment compliance
  • Deep knowledge of payroll processing, payroll taxes, deductions, and payroll liabilities
  • Experience administering benefits, PTO/leave, workers' compensation, and retirement plans
  • Strong HRIS experience and confidence managing employee data and workflows
  • Experience managing audits, reconciliations, and compliance requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with discretion
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions
  • A process-oriented mindset with a desire to continuously improve how things are done
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, growing company where processes are continually evolving

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Experience supporting multiple companies, entities, or business lines
  • Experience in a high-growth or startup environment
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple states
  • Experience with Rippling or a similar HRIS

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means the day-to-day People operations run smoothly and employees have a reliable, knowledgeable HR resource.

You will create confidence that:

  • Payroll is accurate and on time
  • Employee questions are answered quickly and effectively
  • Benefits and leave are administered correctly
  • HR compliance requirements are proactively managed
  • Employee records and HR systems are accurate
  • Onboarding and offboarding processes run smoothly
  • Audits, reconciliations, and administrative requirements don't fall through the cracks
  • HR processes are documented, organized, and scalable
  • Issues are identified and solved before they become bigger problems

Most importantly, you will become the person leadership can trust to say, "I've got it."

Why WarriorBabe?

You'll be joining a growing company with an ambitious mission and the opportunity to help build something from the ground up.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a perfectly established HR department and simply maintain it. We're growing quickly, expanding into new business lines, and building the infrastructure to support that growth.

You'll Have the Opportunity To:

  • Own meaningful HR responsibilities with real autonomy
  • Partner closely with People and executive leadership
  • Build and improve scalable HR processes and systems
  • Make a tangible impact on the employee experience
  • Help strengthen the People function as WarriorBabe grows
  • Grow your career and take on greater responsibility as the company evolves

If you're an experienced HR professional who loves ownership, problem-solving, compliance, and building better processes and is ready to grow your career in a meaningful way, we'd love to meet you.

Salary Range: $65,000 - $75,000

We are Black Rifle Coffee Company, a veteran-founded company serving premium, fresh-roasted coffee to people who love America. We have a love for coffee, dogs, the outdoors, America, and most importantly, our customers! We are more than a product and more than a company; we are a culture. A culture full of motivated people who roll up their sleeves and get the job done with integrity, love, innovation, and radical transparency. Join us as we take action on our commitment to provide quality coffee and give back to the veteran and first responder communities and those who support it.

Job Summary

The Key Account Manager – Grocery is responsible for driving profitable growth across a portfolio of regional grocery customers, including H-E-B, Meijer, Hy-Vee, Schnucks, Brookshire Brothers, and Rouses Markets. This role will directly own retailer relationships, annual business planning, distribution growth, trade investments, and overall account performance to deliver net revenue, market share, and gross margin objectives.

The ideal candidate has direct CPG sales experience managing major grocery retailers, with specific experience working directly with H-E-B or Meijer corporate teams strongly preferred. This individual should be comfortable independently managing a complex portfolio of accounts

Job Details

Base compensation for this role is $90,000-$110,000 annually.

Leadership and Functional Responsibilities

  • Customer Development: Directly own and develop retailer relationships across assigned accounts. Serve as the primary BRCC contact for buyers and key customer stakeholders, leading line reviews, negotiations, promotional planning, new item sell-in, and distribution initiatives.

  • Vision & Planning: Translate annual operating plans into customer-specific Joint Business Plans (JBPs) and growth strategies focused on revenue, distribution, assortment, shelf presence, and market share.

  • Fiscal Management: Own customer P&Ls and manage trade spending, pricing, promotional investments, deductions, and customer agreements to drive profitable growth.

  • Business Performance: Analyze sales, velocity, distribution, promotional performance, and customer profitability to identify opportunities and proactively address performance gaps across the portfolio.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Sales, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Marketing to support forecasting, retail execution, customer initiatives, and long-term account growth.

Travel Requirements

25-30% travel to support retailer meetings, line reviews, customer planning sessions, market visits, and other business needs. Some weekend travel may be required.

Education and Skill Requirements

  • Minimum 3+ years of sales or key account management experience within CPG, with direct grocery retail experience strongly preferred.

  • Direct experience working with H-E-B or Meijer corporate teams required, including buyer relationships, line reviews, annual planning, promotions, and distribution growth.

  • Demonstrated experience directly owning retailer relationships and a multi-account book of business, including revenue and customer P&L responsibility.

  • Strong understanding of grocery retail economics, including trade spending, pricing, promotional planning, forecasting, customer profitability, and Joint Business Planning.

  • Strong analytical, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills with the ability to independently analyze account performance and translate insights into customer growth strategies.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work/Physical Requirements

This is a full-time position and may require long hours and may require weekend and nights work per events

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to, stand, sit; talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone keyboard reach, stoop kneel to install computer equipment

  • Light to moderate lifting is required

  • Ability to uphold the stress of traveling

  • Regular, predictable attendance is required; including quarter-driven hours as business demands dictate.

  • Moderate noise (i.e. business office with computers, phone, and printers, light traffic).

  • Ability to work in a confined area.

  • Ability to sit at a computer terminal for an extended period of time.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Remote Principal Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) – Linux Kernel & AI Platform

Why This Opportunity?

This is a remote opportunity for a senior technical leader who enjoys solving complex, low-level infrastructure challenges and building scalable testing solutions. In this role, you will lead the test strategy and automation for a highly distributed, custom Linux-based AI and Compute platform. You will own the testing lifecycle for a custom Linux kernel, develop advanced automation and continuous testing infrastructure, and work closely with core engineering teams to ensure the platform delivers exceptional performance, reliability, and security at a global scale.

What We're Looking For (Required & Elite Qualifications)

To land this role, you must possess an exceptional command of low-level systems engineering and modern, hyperscale test automation. We are filtering for candidates who meet the following high-bar, non-negotiable criteria:

  • Professional Experience: 12+ years of relevant software engineering, development, or deep systems test experience in massive-scale or distributed environments.
  • Systems Development & Validation: Advanced, hands-on software development and validation experience using C, with a strict focus on Linux kernel-level infrastructure.
  • Automation & Scripting:Expert-level capability in system-level automation and infrastructure validation using scripting tools like Python, Shell, and/or Perl.
  • Linux Kernel Internals:Deep, comprehensive, and structural knowledge of the following Linux internals:
  • KVM and virtualization hypervisors
  • Virtio drivers and driver architecture
  • cgroups and resource isolation
  • Memory management, File systems, and Block I/O
  • Ethernet/network drivers and the TCP/IP stack [
  • Diagnostics & Optimization: Extensive, hands-on experience with Linux kernel debugging tools and advanced performance benchmarking utilities.
  • CI/CD Infrastructure: Proven track record designing, building, and supporting robust continuous integration (CI) and automated testing frameworks for low-level systems.
  • Problem Solving: Superior, proven ability to systematically troubleshoot complex, non-deterministic system-level issues across highly technical environments.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent deeply technical practical experience.

What You'll Do

  • Kernel Test Strategy: Lead the comprehensive test strategy, validation standards, and quality benchmarks for a custom Linux kernel supporting next-gen AI and Compute platforms.
  • Framework Architecture:Design, build, and scale advanced automated test frameworks and suites focused on performance, reliability, security, and new Linux kernel enhancements.
  • Infrastructure Evolution:Support porting existing modifications to newer kernel and VM infrastructure versions while continuously improving build, automation, and continuous integration/testing infrastructure.
  • Low-Level Debugging:Perform deep Linux kernel debugging, performance benchmarking, and system-level validation. Troubleshoot and isolate complex, low-level system issues across test and simulated production environments.
  • Engineering Partnerships: Partner directly with core engineering and architecture teams to establish rigid quality standards and deliver highly reliable infrastructure at scale.
  • Technical Leadership:Provide high-impact technical direction, code reviews, architectural oversight, and mentorship to other engineers across a highly distributed, remote environment
