raw.title: Senior Government & Community Relations Manager, Australia
raw.excerpt: About HipcampOver the past decade, Hipcamp has unlocked access to 5 million acres of private camping around the world.
raw.description:
About Hipcamp

Over the past decade, Hipcamp has unlocked access to 5 million acres of private camping around the world. In addition to hosting over 120k campsites you won’t find anywhere else, Hipcamp also has the best collection of bookable tent, RV and cabin sites for all camping styles. Each year, Hipcamp helps millions of people happily sleep under the stars, boosting local economies and biodiversity along the way. Everything we do is guided by our belief that getting outside is good for the health of people and the environment. Our culture is built on a deep and genuine commitment to helping people connect with the outdoors. Hipcamp is also backed by top tier investors including Andreesen Horowitz, Benchmark, Bond Capital and Index Ventures.

As Hipcamp Australia continues to grow, we’re looking for a highly proactive and independent person who can work across government relations, media, policy, community engagement and industry partnerships, with the opportunity to play a key role in shaping the next stage of our Australian business.

About the role

Hipcamp is looking for a strategic, highly independent government affairs leader to help build a safe, durable future for low-impact camping on private land across Australia.

In this role, you will lead Hipcamp’s government affairs strategy across Australia with a focus on reducing regulatory risk, strengthening relationships with decision-makers, and creating the conditions for long-term market growth and Host retention. You will work primarily at the state and local level, with a particular focus on navigating council planning systems, engaging planning departments and elected officials, participating in public processes, and building strategic partnerships that can influence policy and regulatory outcomes.

This is a highly autonomous role. The rest of Hipcamp’s Government and Community Relations team is based in the United States, across significantly different time zones, so you will be the primary government affairs leader on the ground in Australia and a solo operator. You will need to be comfortable operating independently, setting your own priorities with your manager, making sound strategic decisions, and moving work forward without frequent direction or day-to-day support from the broader team. You will also work with a small, distributed Australia-based team across company functions.

You are a sophisticated relationship builder and strategic operator who understands that government affairs is a long game. You will need to be exceptionally good at building trust, understanding different perspectives, navigating adversarial conversations, and finding paths toward constructive outcomes, even when the starting point is challenging. You know how to identify who actually influences a decision, build relationships before you need them, navigate complex planning and political processes, and bring together unlikely partners around shared interests. You are comfortable working through ambiguity and setbacks and know when to push, when to negotiate, when to build broader support, and when to change course.

What you'll do

  • Own Hipcamp’s government affairs strategy across Australia, identifying and prioritising the regulatory risks and opportunities that have the greatest potential impact on Host growth and retention.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with local and state decision-makers, including councillors, mayors, council CEOs, planning staff, tourism officials, state government officials, and other influential stakeholders.
  • Navigate council planning systems and public processes to influence outcomes, including planning proposals, development processes, public consultations, hearings, working groups, and other government engagement opportunities.
  • Develop strategies to prevent, mitigate, and resolve regulatory threats to avoid significant marketplace disruption.
  • Represent Hipcamp as a constructive, solutions-oriented participant in public discourse and the media on topics including: land use, tourism, outdoor recreation, agriculture, and regional economic development.
  • Build strategic partnerships with organisations including agritourism and farming associations, tourism and destination management organisations, outdoor recreation groups, conservation organisations, caravan and camping associations, and public land managers to influence state and local decision-makers.
  • Develop relationships with Hipcamp Hosts and other community stakeholders and, where appropriate, engage them as credible voices in government affairs efforts.
  • Use media, public affairs, community engagement, research, data, and other advocacy tools to help shape our work and priorities.
  • Bring the Australian government and political landscape into the broader GCR team’s strategic planning while independently owning execution in Australia.
  • Develop clear recommendations for senior leadership based on political dynamics, stakeholder relationships, regulatory risk, business impact, and likelihood of success.
  • Travel regularly within Australia to build relationships, participate in government processes, and support priority markets. International travel may also be required.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years’ experience in government relations, public policy, politics, advocacy or public affairs, with a strong track record of influencing state and/or local government outcomes in Australia.
  • Deep understanding of Australian local government planning processes, including council planning processes, planning schemes, elected member dynamics, community consultation, and decision-making.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and navigate complex or politically challenging environments, with strong political judgement and an ability to read stakeholder motivations and institutional dynamics.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, including the ability to build trust across political and professional differences and turn challenging stakeholder relationships into productive ones.
  • Experience in community organising, coalition-building and strategic partnerships across government, industry, community and advocacy groups. Media, public affairs and/or grassroots advocacy experience is highly regarded.
  • Strategic and analytical thinker who can assess regulatory risks and opportunities, use evidence to build compelling arguments, and prioritise the issues that matter most to the business.
  • Highly self-directed and comfortable working with significant autonomy, exercising sound judgement and adapting strategy as circumstances change.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with planners, councillors, industry leaders, community members and senior executives.
  • High standards of integrity and confidentiality, and a passion for supporting rural and regional communities, responsible land stewardship and greater access to the outdoors.
  • Comfortable working remotely across time zones and travelling domestically and internationally up to 25%.

About our Work Environment

Compensation will be a mix of salary and stock options. It will be highly competitive compared to similar-stage companies and based on location.

Health is essential to happiness. In addition to full health insurance, all team members receive $1K in Hipcash because we believe getting outside is excellent preventative medicine in addition to increasing your creativity, lowering your stress, and making you an overall more awesome human.

We focus on results, not hours. We believe that clearly defined goals combined with great people, empowerment, and autonomy create the best results. We feel confident that inclusive and diverse teams working on an important cause can accomplish extraordinary things.

Hipcamp is an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. In fact we are confident that the most inclusive and diverse teams accomplish the most extraordinary results.

raw.description:
Job Description:

The Engagement Manager, Eightfold is responsible for leading successful client engagements across The Groove’s growing Eightfold practice. This role serves as a primary point of contact for clients and is accountable for overall project delivery, including scope, timeline, budget, resources, risks, quality, and client satisfaction.

The Engagement Manager works closely with Eightfold consultants, technical resources, client stakeholders, and The Groove leadership to ensure projects are well planned, effectively governed, and delivered in alignment with client objectives.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead Eightfold implementation and consulting engagements from project initiation through deployment and stabilization.

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day client contact and build strong, trusted relationships with client stakeholders and project leadership.

  • Own overall project delivery, including scope, schedule, budget, resource planning, risks, issues, dependencies, and quality.

  • Develop and maintain project plans, status reports, governance materials, RAID logs, financial tracking, and other project documentation.

  • Facilitate project kickoff meetings, status meetings, steering committee discussions, and other client governance activities.

  • Partner with functional and technical team members to establish project priorities, coordinate activities, and ensure successful execution.

  • Manage project scope and identify potential changes early, partnering with leadership and clients to address change requests appropriately.

  • Monitor engagement financials, including project budget, forecast, utilization, and overall delivery health.

  • Identify project risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate concerns proactively when needed.

  • Ensure project milestones, deliverables, and client commitments are clearly defined, tracked, and achieved.

  • Support clients through key project decisions, organizational dependencies, testing, deployment readiness, and change management activities.

  • Coordinate across Eightfold, Workday, integration, data, reporting, and other project teams as needed to support successful delivery.

  • Manage client expectations and communicate project status, risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly and professionally.

  • Provide leadership and guidance to project team members and help create a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team environment.

  • Partner with sales and practice leadership during project transitions, scoping discussions, and expansion opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes, strengthen delivery processes, and expand The Groove’s relationship with existing clients.

  • Contribute to the development of Eightfold delivery methodologies, templates, tools, and reusable practice assets.

  • Represent The Groove professionally and model our values in all client and team interactions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in consulting, professional services, enterprise technology implementation, project management, or a related field.

  • 3+ years of experience leading enterprise technology implementation projects or client engagements.

  • Demonstrated experience managing project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, issues, and client expectations.

  • Experience leading cross-functional project teams in a client-facing consulting environment.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS implementation methodologies and project lifecycles.

  • Experience facilitating client meetings, project governance, executive communications, and status reporting.

  • Strong financial and commercial awareness, including experience managing project budgets, forecasts, and scope.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify risks, resolve issues, manage escalations, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both project teams and executive stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and engagements.

  • Ability to build strong client relationships and establish credibility as a trusted advisor.

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed, and client-facing consulting environment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience implementing or supporting Eightfold AI or another talent intelligence or HR technology platform.

  • Experience with talent acquisition, recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, or other HR technology solutions.

  • Experience working within the Workday ecosystem or for a Workday services partner.

  • Experience managing Workday, Eightfold, or other enterprise SaaS implementations.

  • Experience managing projects that include multiple technology platforms or third-party integrations.

  • Experience supporting sales pursuits, project scoping, statements of work, or expansion opportunities.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Eightfold implementation delivery

  • Engagement and project management

  • Client relationship management

  • Scope and change management

  • Project financial management

  • Risk and issue management

  • Project governance

  • Cross-functional team leadership

  • SaaS implementation methodology

EEO Policy:

The Groove is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetics, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran or marital status.

Ready to embark on an exhilarating journey of innovation and collaboration? Apply nowand be part of our exciting team at The Groove!

raw.description:
We are seeking an innovative Instructional Designer to join our Organizational Development team and help create impactful learning experiences that drive employee growth and business performance across the organization. In this role, you will partner with multiple business divisions to assess training needs, design effective learning solutions, and develop engaging content that supports enterprise-wide initiatives. You will lead the creation and delivery of instructor-led, virtual, eLearning, microlearning, and blended learning programs, while managing instructional development projects from analysis through implementation using the ADDIE methodology.

This role supports enterprise-wide training initiatives and partners with multiple business areas to design learning solutions that meet organizational needs. Responsibilities include developing microlearning, online learning, and classroom-based training experiences for employees across the organization.

In addition to the core job requirements, our ideal candidate will have:

  • Experience in instructional systems design, online course development, and SCORM-compliant content creation
  • Proficiency with Articulate 360 (Storyline, Presenter, Quizmaker, and Engage), Camtasia, SnagIt, Adobe eLearning tools, and Microsoft Office
  • Experience creating multimedia learning assets, editing audio and voiceovers, and supporting content delivery through learning platforms
  • Advanced AI capabilities that include leveraging generative AI tools to streamline content development, create learning assets, generate storyboards and assessment content, enhance learner engagement, and improve the efficiency of training design and delivery
  • Strong organizational and professional skills, with the ability to translate complex business concepts into engaging learner-centered experiences, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and work effectively both independently and across cross-functional teams

Note:

  • Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Job Responsibilities

  • Evaluating the effectiveness of audiovisual materials to ensure objectives are being accomplished.

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description:

The Media Relations Manager helps protect and elevate Baker Tilly's image and reputation by leading day-to-day media relations strategy and execution. Reporting to the public relations director, this position translates firmwide business and growth priorities into proactive earned media strategies, key messages and timely responses to media inquiries. The manager serves as a strategic adviser to leaders and subject matter experts, oversees relationships with third-party public relations agencies and coordinates media outreach, spokesperson preparation, announcements and integrated promotion across public relations, marketing, social media and creative teams.

This role provides functional leadership, coaching, workload coordination and quality review for media relations team members and may include direct supervision. The manager tracks media results and social engagement, evaluates the quality and business relevance of coverage and uses data to adjust strategy and advise leadership.

The successful candidate must demonstrate an unwavering commitment to the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism. This role involves sensitive projects where sound judgment and discretion are paramount. The ideal candidate has a proven record of handling proprietary and confidential information with care and integrity.

Responsibilities

Media Strategy and Reputation Management:

  • Develop and execute media relations strategies that advance Baker Tilly's business priorities, strengthen the firm's reputation and support go-to-market plans.

  • Translate complex business, industry, regulatory and technical topics into clear messages, compelling story angles and timely media opportunities.

  • Counsel the public relations director, firm leaders and subject matter experts on media strategy, reputational considerations, executive visibility and response approaches.

  • Monitor news and emerging issues in real time and support issues management and crisis communications in partnership with the public relations director.

  • Evaluate awards, rankings, sponsorships and other visibility opportunities for credibility, cost and strategic fit.

Media Relations and Spokesperson Management:

  • Build and maintain relationships with national business, financial, trade, industry and regional media.

  • Lead proactive pitching and manage inbound media inquiries, evaluating each opportunity for relevance, risk, timing, message alignment and spokesperson fit.

  • Identify, prepare and coach executives and subject matter experts for interviews. Develop briefing materials, talking points, written responses and follow-up plans.

  • Oversee the development, review and approval of pitches, press releases, bylined articles, media statements, award submissions and other external materials.

  • Coordinate post-placement promotion across social media and digital channels to extend the reach and value of earned coverage.

Agency and Program Management:

  • Direct the day-to-day work of external public relations agencies, set priorities, align strategy and messaging, review deliverables and assess performance.

  • Establish efficient workflows, project plans, timelines and systems for media inquiries, campaigns, announcements and recurring agency work.

  • Lead regular agency and internal team check-ins, ensuring clear ownership, timely decisions and effective follow-through.

  • Partner with the public relations director on agency scopes, resource allocation and budget considerations.

  • Maintain media lists, process documentation and shared tools that improve coordination and continuity.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Provide functional leadership, coaching, feedback, workload coordination and quality review for media relations team members.

  • Assign or coordinate work across specialists and agency partners based on business priorities, capacity, expertise and deadlines.

  • May directly supervise one or more team members, depending on business needs, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, performance discussions and professional development.

  • Foster a collaborative and accountable team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

  • Help build team readiness and coverage for high-volume or fast-turn media cycles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integrated Communications:

  • Partner with leaders and teams across the organization to understand business priorities, key messages, client needs and emerging opportunities.

  • Build alignment with marketing, social media, creative, internal communications and other stakeholders to deliver integrated campaigns.

  • Lead or support communications for firmwide announcements, mergers and acquisitions, executive initiatives, research and thought leadership.

  • Serve as a bridge between public relations, business leaders and external partners, managing reviews and approvals while maintaining momentum.

Measurement and Optimization:

  • Establish goals and key performance indicators for media relations initiatives.

  • Monitor and analyze earned media coverage, message pull-through, spokesperson visibility, social engagement and other relevant outcomes.

  • Produce regular reports and executive-ready updates on public relations activity, results, opportunities and risks.

  • Use performance data and qualitative insights to recommend improvements to media strategy, agency priorities and campaign execution.

  • Monitor competitor activity and shifts in the media landscape to identify opportunities and inform planning.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in public relations, communications, journalism, marketing or a related field.

  • Six or more years of progressive experience in public relations or media relations, including experience leading complex campaigns, agency partners, projects or team members. Direct people management experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated success developing media strategies that support business priorities and secure high-quality national, business or trade coverage.

  • Strong knowledge of the business media landscape and experience building productive relationships with reporters, editors and producers.

  • Experience identifying and preparing executives and subject matter experts for interviews and fast-turn media opportunities.

  • Exceptional writing, editing and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical or complex topics for external audiences.

  • Strong project management, organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-profile workstreams under tight deadlines.

  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle sensitive information and reputational issues with discretion and professionalism.

  • Familiarity with media monitoring, media database and analytics tools and the ability to use data to guide decisions.

  • Experience with integrated social media promotion and cross-functional campaign planning.

  • Familiarity with accounting, consulting, finance or professional services industries preferred.

The pay rate range for this job position is $72,000 to $150,400. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of relevant factors including but not limited to applicant’s skills, prior experience, qualifications, degrees, professional certifications, work arrangements and geographic location. Baker Tilly offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to eligible employees.

Customer Support Representative - Chat (Remote - US hours)

At SimpleTexting, we’re seeking a hard-working Customer Support Specialist to help customers troubleshoot tricky (and not-so-tricky) problems all day, every day. The ideal candidate is comfortable switching gears quickly, and passionate about helping people. We pride ourselves on amazing customer service. In this role, you’d be the heart and soul of SimpleTexting.

Responsibilities

  • You’re a superhero, but with a computer instead of a cape. Respond to inquiries and issues via online chat to help SimpleTexting customers.
  • You’ll clarify the customer’s needs, determine the cause, select and explain the best solution, then follow-up to make sure the issue is resolved. The whole enchilada.
  • You’ll be a compliance expert - making sure our customers are responsible texters.
  • Participate in writing excellent help documentation—both for internal use and for our customers
  • Escalate bugs to our customer technical support team
  • Work on specialized projects, as you become more comfortable in the role

  • Become a SimpleTexting power user—before you can support others, you must know the product yourself.

This Role Is For You If

  • You love to talk, actively listen, and build relationships
  • You enjoy responding to a customer’s inquiry in the way that makes the most sense. We’re a conversational, human support team, not a scripted one.
  • You leverage templates efficiently, while ensuring every response feels personal and intentional
  • Multiple chats happening at once doesn’t make you sweat
  • You thrive in fast-paced environments
  • You’re as comfortable hopping on the phone as you are writing super clear emails
  • Investigating issues when you don’t have enough info to resolve them is your idea of fun
  • Going above and beyond for customers gives you a warm and fuzzy feeling
  • You have no shame geeking out about business and technology

Required Qualifications

  • English is your primary language. Secondary languages are a plus.
  • At least 1 year of experience providing live chat customer support for a software/SaaS platform (or equivalent).
  • You can translate technical ideas for non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrable critical thinking, communication, and creative problem-solving skills
  • Ability to learn new software platforms quickly
  • Self-starter, positive attitude, ability to continuously develop and adapt to a growing team
  • Highly organized. You can manage and prioritize several different projects.
  • Familiarity chat and CRM platforms
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a related field of study
  • 2+ years in customer support role

About Us

SimpleTexting is the leading web-based platform for SMS marketing and business texting. Our software gives organizations the ability to send marketing campaigns, share important alerts, and provide 1-on-1 customer service using text messages. Thousands of organizations in North America rely on SimpleTexting to connect with their audiences. Our clients include Fortune 500 companies, small businesses, nonprofits, healthcare providers, churches, schools, and more. And with a powerful suite of features that includes segments, autoresponders, data collection and analytics, our platform is designed to help businesses start and scale their engagement through SMS.

SimpleTexting is proudly part of Sinch, a leading global Communication Platform as a Service (CPaaS) provider, offering messaging, voice and video communication solutions to a large global customer base. Sinch’s APIs and platform deal with over 145 billion engagements annually. Enterprise customers include 8 out of 10 of the largest US tech companies by market capitalization, major airlines, banks, retail, e-tail, internet, ride-hailing, parcel delivery companies and more

Our values of Dream big, Win together, Keep it simple and Make it happen are what make us successful on our journey to be the global leader in customer engagement for SMBs, so people who feel a connection to these values and like the pace of a fast-growing global company will easily fit into our team. We are committed to building a company that empowers individuals from a diverse set of backgrounds to be their authentic self and bring their values into their work. We know that the more diverse and inclusive we are, the better our success will be.

If you’re looking for the next opportunity in your career and want to work for a growing tech company, then apply now!

Who are we?
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities, so if you are ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

Role Description

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare monthly consolidated management accounts and coordinate delivery across stakeholders.

  • Analyse profit and loss performance and investigate key variances.

  • Assist with the preparation of statutory financial statements, including group reporting.

  • Support month-end and year-end close processes to ensure timely and accurate reporting.

Business Partnering

  • Partner with operational teams to ensure robust processes, training and accurate financial accounting.

  • Support business decision-making through financial analysis and insight.

  • Challenge assumptions and provide constructive financial recommendations where appropriate.

  • Present financial information and analysis to the VP of Finance to support strategic decision-making.

Controls & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with UK accounting standards and internal policies.

  • Manage tax compliance for the parent company and subsidiary entities.

  • Maintain and strengthen financial controls and governance processes.

  • Support internal and external audit activities.

  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and utilise the ERP system (e.g. Xero, JOINN, Quickbooks).

  • Develop and enhance financial reporting using Excel and business intelligence tools.

  • Drive finance process improvements and automation where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with AltoVita’s Product team to ensure governance and compliance across new product releases

Requirements

Qualifications

  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified.

  • Minimum of one year of post-qualification experience (PQE).

  • Previous audit experience is desirable.

  • At least one year of industry experience.

Skills & Experience

  • Strong technical knowledge of:

    • Management accounting

    • Financial reporting

    • Variance analysis

    • Balance sheet reconciliations

    • UK GAAP (IFRS knowledge is desirable)

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

  • Experience working in a fast-paced commercial environment.

  • Exposure to process improvement and finance automation initiatives.

  • Strong commercial awareness.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to prioritise competing deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • Proactive, organised and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

  • Strong commercial awareness.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • High attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to prioritise competing deadlines and manage multiple tasks effectively.

  • Proactive, organised and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

  • Remote work set-up with minimum bi-annual office visits

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

Join our Team

AltoVita is the sum of every member of the team. We know that a strong team is a diverse team, and are therefore committed to being an equal opportunity employer, so please bring all of yourself to the interviews and most importantly to our team.

Becoming an AltoVitian means you will benefit from:

  • A team that will always put you first

  • Incredible opportunities for growth and career advancement

  • A fully-remote working environment

  • Wellness benefits and a wellness budget, which can be spent on a range of options including gym memberships, home meal delivery services, mindfulness applications, and many more

  • A work-from-home allowance to get your home-office set up

  • A generous vacation package so you can recharge or explore

About the Opportunity

Our client is an early-stage technology company developing AI-driven cyber risk intelligence and compliance solutions for organisations operating in increasingly complex security environments.

The business is developing a growing portfolio of cyber intelligence and quantum-security solutions and is now looking for a Demand Generation Manager who can help translate that product proposition into market awareness, engaged communities and a qualified pipeline.

This is a hands-on opportunity rather than a traditional corporate marketing position.

You will be joining a pre-revenue, early-stage venture where the emphasis at this stage is on building market traction, developing the demand engine and contributing to the company's longer-term growth.

The engagement is therefore likely to be particularly suited to someone who is comfortable participating in an early-stage venture alongside other professional commitments and is motivated by longer-term participation in the growth and value created by the business, rather than someone seeking a conventional full-time employment structure.

Further details regarding the engagement and participation structure will be discussed directly with candidates progressing through the process.

Application

Please submit your CV together with a short note outlining:

  • Your experience building B2B demand-generation campaigns
  • Your hands-on HubSpot experience
  • Your experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager
  • An example of a campaign, community or channel you personally helped grow
  • Any experience you have marketing cybersecurity, technology or other complex B2B products

Please read the full opportunity carefully before applying.

What You'll Be Doing

You will help build and operate the company's early demand-generation engine across digital, community and B2B channels.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and running demand-generation campaigns across LinkedIn, email, webinars and content
  • Developing market awareness and engagement across relevant cybersecurity communities
  • Supporting organic social activity across LinkedIn, X, Facebook and other relevant channels
  • Identifying opportunities to build engaged communities across platforms such as Instagram and TikTok
  • Managing social content calendars, scheduling, publishing and engagement reporting
  • Shaping messaging for CISOs, risk leaders, compliance teams, SMEs and innovation leaders
  • Creating nurture journeys for complex B2B buying committees
  • Supporting lead generation and conversion activity
  • Managing and improving marketing automation and lifecycle workflows
  • Supporting funnel tracking, attribution and performance reporting
  • Turning technical cybersecurity concepts into clear and engaging market-facing narratives
  • Testing channels, messaging and campaigns and using the resulting data to improve performance

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

This role requires genuine hands-on HubSpot capability rather than basic end-user familiarity.

You should be comfortable with:

  • Building and managing workflows
  • Email sequences
  • Forms and lifecycle automation
  • List segmentation
  • Lead and campaign reporting
  • Marketing automation processes

Experience taking meaningful ownership of HubSpot within a previous organisation will be particularly valuable.

Analytics & Performance

Particularly Valuable

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:

  • AI or emerging technology

Why This Opportunity?

For someone who enjoys building rather than inheriting established marketing machinery, this is an opportunity to influence the demand-generation approach from an early stage and see the direct impact of their work.

raw.description:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Database Administrator (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a UK-based Inside IR35 role with remote working available. While the role can be performed remotely, candidates based within a reasonable distance of Crawley or London who are happy to work from the office when required would be particularly welcomed.

Requirements

The Role

In this role, you’ll lead critical security, performance, and governance improvements across our SQL Server and Azure database estates.

As a subject matter expert, you’ll take ownership of high-impact projects, bring deep technical expertise to complex challenges, and help shape the future of our database platforms. You’ll also work collaboratively with the wider team, sharing knowledge, developing best practice, and helping to build capability across the DBA function.

Key aspects of the role include:

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box!

  • Drive Security & Governance: Lead the delivery of the CIS Security Improvement Programme across SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, and Azure SQL Managed Instance. Champion the implementation of CIS Benchmark recommendations, audit actions, and security controls such as Row-Level Security, Dynamic Data Masking, and Column-Level Encryption.

  • Strengthen Access Management: Enhance Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), privileged access management, permissions, and segregation of duties to maintain strong security, governance, and regulatory compliance across the database estate.

  • Lead Database Modernisation: Identify and implement approved SQL Server 2022 capabilities, including Ledger, Temporal Tables, Resource Governor, and Memory-Optimised Tables, focusing on solutions that deliver measurable business value.

  • Optimise at Scale: Design and deliver strategies for managing and optimising very large datasets, including databases with 1B+ rows. Apply partitioning, sharding, compression, data lifecycle management, and advanced indexing strategies to improve scalability, resilience, and performance.

  • Share Knowledge & Best Practice: Work collaboratively and openly, producing high-quality technical documentation, operational standards, and knowledge-transfer sessions that strengthen team capability and promote consistent ways of working.

  • Support the Wider DBA Team: Provide occasional reactive DBA support during major incidents or periods of reduced capacity, contributing your expertise to maintain service continuity and help the wider team succeed.

What you’ll bring:

  • Deep technical expertise with SQL Server, Azure SQL Database, and Azure SQL Managed Instance.

  • Practical experience implementing database security frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, RBAC, auditing, encryption).

  • Proven capability in managing large-scale database optimisation, partitioning strategies, and index tuning.

  • Familiarity with SQL Server 2022 advanced features.

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset grounded in empathy, transparency, and accountability.

What to expect from our hiring process:

We believe in radical clarity—no guessing games or high-pressure interrogations. We want to give you every opportunity to shine in your comfort zone:

1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, and office hybrid working model.

2. Initial interview – An opportunity to meet members of our team and discuss your experience, background and interest in the role.

3. Client introduction & interview – A final conversation with the client, including questions focused on the role, your experience and how you would approach the work.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step, ensuring zero surprises right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

Highlights

Waracle are looking for a hands-on Senior Database Administrator (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy.

Role Title: Technical Architect

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

In this role, you'll apply your platform engineering expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world engineering input. No prior experience in AI is required-your domain knowledge and hands-on production experience are what matter.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to design, deploy, troubleshoot, secure, scale, and recover production-grade cloud infrastructure. You will develop realistic scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery, then build reproducible environments, deterministic validation tests, golden reference solutions, and intentionally defective variants.

Responsibilities

  1. Create realistic cloud infrastructure tasks involving distributed systems, networking, security, scalability, and reliability.
  2. Build reproducible, containerized environments with valid reference solutions and intentionally defective variants.
  3. Define measurable requirements across infrastructure configuration, deployed topology, and runtime behavior.
  4. Develop deterministic integration, load, security, failure-injection, deployment, and recovery tests.
  5. Debug environments, document technical decisions, and review tasks created by other experts.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  1. Senior-level technical architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, systems engineering, or SRE experience, including personal ownership of a production platform.
  2. Strong knowledge of distributed systems, scalable APIs, queues, autoscaling, durable storage, and partial-failure scenarios.
  3. Practical experience with IAM, private networking, least-privilege access, and service-to-service security.
  4. Experience with observability, measurable SLOs, rolling deployments, rollback strategies, and disaster recovery.
  5. Ability to write infrastructure automation or testing tools and debug containerized environments using a relevant programming language.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.
  2. Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or multi-cloud infrastructure.
  3. Experience building internal developer platforms, edge infrastructure, or shared platform services.
  4. Experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, local cloud emulators, or resilience testing.
  5. Experience creating technical evaluations, automated grading systems, or AI environments is helpful but not required.

Process:

  1. Apply to the role, filling out the screening questions
  2. Complete AI interview (aprox. 30 minutes), reviewed by recruiters)
  3. Hiring Manager review

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

At The Obama Foundation, our mission is to inspire, empower, and connect people to change their world. We seek to build an active democratic culture where people are equipped and motivated to make change in the communities where they live, work, and play. Right here on the South Side of Chicago, we’re building a home for this vision, a global center for change with a range of opportunities - coordinated programming, community outreach events, educational moments, and more - that invite visitors from down the block or across the globe to turn hope into action.

Achieving our ambitious goals starts with an exceptional team built on our Hope to Action Values - Courage, Empathy, Integrity, Accountability, Community, Inclusivity, Pragmatism, Resilience, Imagination, and Hope. A Framework that anyone, anywhere, can use to build trust, activate participation, and expand opportunity in their community.

Purpose of the Role

As a member of the Legal Team, the Paralegal will support fast-paced, mission-focused work related to legal research, legal document review, contract, compliance and operational support on a wide range of issues. The Paralegal will assist with the drafting and editing of legal documents, special projects, and will help respond to legal inquiries and contract requests.

The Paralegal reports directly to the Deputy General Counsel, Legal Operations, with managerial support from the Senior Paralegal. The Paralegal will also assist in the organizational management of legal documents, ensuring that the team has an effective system for storing and sourcing important information, and will be responsible for the management of the department’s contract management system.

Core Job Responsibilities

  • Review, analyze, and organize complex factual material and other substantive legal documents

  • Monitor system for legal inquiries, responding to business team partners (reviewing materials, etc.) or escalating to attorneys in a timely fashion

  • Assist attorneys in initial review of, and finalizing, Foundation agreements by reviewing contract requests from business team partners, coordinating with business team partners to resolve ambiguities, preparing initial drafts of contracts, and coordinating with the reviewing attorney, business team partners, and third-parties

  • Manage contract management system with an eye towards improving the system with input from business users and other stakeholders at the Foundation

  • Work closely with attorneys on regulatory reporting obligations, implementation of compliance training materials, legal systems optimization, and creation and maintenance of Legal team policies and standard operating procedures and related training efforts

  • Assist with other Legal operations workstreams as directed by manager for department, which may include maintaining Legal team project management trackers, managing outside counsel engagement letters and invoices, and creating reports on Legal operations data

  • Draft and/or edit legal documents as directed by manager for department as needed

  • Perform legal research as directed by manager for department as needed

  • Prepare materials for trainings, internal presentations, and board and executive team meetings

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Key Deliverables / Outcomes

  • Concise explanations of legal research findings

  • Initial drafts of Foundation contracts and memos

  • Organized Legal Team file system containing the Foundation's contracts and other core documents

  • Curated and well-managed contracting system that implements feedback from Foundation partners, and is responsive to the needs of the Legal Team

  • Timely responses to Legal inquiries from Foundation partners, all inquiries are responded to or sent to the appropriate attorney within 24-48 hours

Required Qualifications

  • 4 years of previous paralegal or other legal experience, either at a firm or in-house

  • Excellent writing ability, research skills, and analytical thinking, with confidence to apply research results to fact patterns to propose conclusions or prescriptions

  • Highly organized, with a track record of meeting short- and long-term responsibilities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, high volume organization

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team

  • Prior experience building or maintaining a contract management system, such as Ironclad, a plus but not required

  • Prior experience with Google Suiteand Freshservice a plus but not required

  • Committed to our mission of inspiring, empowering, and connecting people to change their world

The salary range for this role is between $83,600 and $104,500.

This is a remote role based in Chicago.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to still consider submitting an application. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another one of our openings!

Commercial Account Manager – Solar O&M (United States)

About Otovo

Otovo is an AI-driven provider of energy services for residential and commercial markets across Europe and the United States. We integrate live asset monitoring, accelerated maintenance, and grid engagement into a unified platform to provide superior performance at a competitive price. Powered by Endurance—our proprietary AI technology—we oversee system health, automate service workflows from diagnostics to completion, and manage round-the-clock technical support. "Your Power, Backed by Ours." Otovo is publicly traded on the Euronext Oslo Stock Exchange (OTOVO)

Position Summary

The Commercial Account Manager – Solar O&M is responsible for driving B2B revenue growth across commercial and enterprise accounts by structuring and selling long-term Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contracts, asset management solutions, monitoring services, and performance-focused service programs. Reporting to the VP of Global Sales, this role leads sales efforts with enterprise customers and multi-site commercial portfolios, targeting Fortune 500 enterprises, commercial & industrial (C&I) property owners, independent power producers (IPPs), and renewable energy asset managers.

Operating at the intersection of commercial solar and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), this role combines strong technical knowledge with disciplined enterprise sales execution. The Commercial Account Manager partners closely with engineering, legal, finance, and the internal Solar Service Operations group to structure custom service agreements that position Otovo as a trusted long-term O&M partner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute a national sales strategy targeting commercial, industrial, and institutional asset owners to secure long-term solar O&M, monitoring, and asset management agreements.

  • Proactively identify, target, and close enterprise and multi-site portfolio opportunities with C-suite executives, sustainability leaders, facilities teams, and asset management stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with engineering, legal, finance, and operations teams to model, draft, and negotiate custom service level agreements (SLAs), preventative maintenance scopes, corrective repair programs, monitoring solutions, asset management services, and performance guarantees.

  • Partner closely with the internal Solar Service Operations group to ensure proposed solutions align with operational capacity, regional pricing, technical requirements, and deployment schedules.

  • Position Otovo as a trusted O&M partner for complex commercial solar and storage portfolios, including monitoring, asset management, inverter repowering, SCADA upgrades, and BESS optimization services.

  • Maintain an accurate, metrics-driven sales pipeline in the CRM and provide reliable quarterly and annual revenue forecasts to executive leadership.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of successful B2B sales experience in renewable energy, energy services, or a related sector, including at least 5 years focused on commercial/industrial solar O&M, asset management, monitoring, or technical service sales.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding significant annual sales targets, with demonstrated success closing institutional, enterprise, or multi-site portfolio contracts.

  • Strong working knowledge of commercial solar technology, including central/string inverters, SCADA/DAS monitoring infrastructure, thermal imaging, and utility-scale or C&I Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

  • Expertise in analyzing project financial models, understanding NPV/IRR impacts of asset downtime, and translating performance data into tangible ROI conversations for clients.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Sustainability, or a related technical discipline.

  • Ability to travel domestically up to 40% to meet prospective clients, attend industry conferences, and visit major portfolio sites.

Preferred Certifications

  • NABCEP (North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners) certification

  • MBA or other industry-specific technical certification

Physical & Work Environment

  • Ability to travel domestically up to 90% of the time to client sites, portfolio locations, and industry conferences.

  • Ability to work remotely with periodic in-person client and site visits.

  • May require occasional site walk-throughs at active commercial/industrial solar and BESS installations.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $80,000–$145,000 base salary (based on experience, qualifications, and market considerations), plus commission earnings in accordance with the company’s commission plan.

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefit packages.

  • Enrollment in a 401(k) retirement savings plan featuring employer matching contributions

  • Generous paid time off policy encompassing vacation days, sick leave, and observed company holidays.

Why Join Otovo?

At Otovo, we're helping accelerate the world's transition to clean energy by making solar energy simple and accessible. As our Commercial Account Manager – Solar O&M, you'll have the opportunity to build lasting O&M and asset management partnerships with enterprise and commercial accounts while shaping how Otovo shows up in the C&I market. If you're passionate about consultative enterprise sales, technical solar and storage solutions, and driving long-term recurring revenue, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
COMPANY

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.
DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 item in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.
We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

Role Overview:

This role exists first to close the gap between what R&D and ideation create and what actually runs, reliably and at full scale, on a co-manufacturer's equipment. It starts with taking a formula from gold-standard bench sample through trial, first production, and continuous improvement. Once a product is running cleanly, this person stays connected as a technical resource to the wider site-facing quality team, so the process knowledge and relationships built during commercialization inform ongoing production rather than getting handed off and lost. This is a new position on the Manufacturing team, created because our fastest-growing need isn't more ideation; it's the ability to take what R&D and ideation create land it intact at full manufacturing scale and then keep it running to spec day to day. The ideal person has lived on both sides of that line: formulation and scale-up trials on one side, hands-on plant and quality experience (blenders, augers, packaging lines, audits) on the other.

What You'll Own

Commercialization & Scale-Up (primary focus):

  • Own the transition of new formulas from bench-top “gold standard” samples through plant trials, first production runs, and continuous improvement, ensuring the process, not just the recipe, transfers to each manufacturer's specific equipment (e.g., tumble blenders vs. ribbon blenders vs. V-blenders).
  • Loop in early on new formulations, before they're finalized, to flag equipment or process mismatches before they become a rework problem.
  • Partner with the sensory and R&D teams to determine whether a site-specific standard is warranted when equipment differences make an exact match to the master gold standard impractical, and document the rationale.
  • Lead the handoff from trial/first production into steady-state production, staying attached to the SKU and site rather than dropping it once it's running.
  • Partner with New Product Launch teams during launch planning to confirm our manufacturing network has the equipment and process capability to take a product from pilot production to full-scale, everyday production runs, flagging capability gaps early enough to address them before launch.
  • Support the Sr. Director of Manufacturing & Supply in maintaining a clear, current view of existing and prospective manufacturing capabilities across the network, and help organize a portfolio of manufacturers so future projects can be matched to the right site with confidence.

Guidance to the Site-Facing Technical/Quality Team:

  • Act as a resource and advisor to the wider site-facing technical/quality team, sharing the process and equipment context built during commercialization so they can troubleshoot day-to-day production issues without starting from scratch.
  • Provide insight on performance against sensory and quality targets set by the sensory/R&D team, helping the site-facing team interpret drift and connect it back to the original scale-up intent.
  • Lend expertise to site audits (SQF, BRC, customer audits) as needed, helping pressure-test risk assessments and confirm corrective/preventive actions go deeper than “retraining,” without owning the audit relationship day to day.
  • Flag when a site's day-to-day practice appears to be drifting from what's documented, and route it to the site-facing quality owner for follow-up.

Issue Support & Root-Cause Investigation:

  • Support root-cause investigations when something breaks (an out-of-spec test result, a quality deviation, an ingredient or process failure) by contributing process knowledge and clarity on how the product is expected to be produced at that specific co-man.
  • This role is not the required first responder; it strengthens the investigation rather than owning the initial response.
  • Coordinate with the broader manufacturing coverage team and site-facing quality owners so investigations draw on the right process expertise without depending on any one person's availability.

Relationship Management:

  • Build genuine, collaborative relationships with co-manufacturer teams (quality, engineering, and operations) grounded in the mindset that Ryze and the co-man are on the same team working the same problem.
  • Represent Ryze's standards clearly and directly, including in difficult conversations, while maintaining the trust needed for co-mans to raise issues early rather than hide them.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor Degree preferred plus 8 years of experience.
  • Experience spanning both R&D/formulation scale-up (bench → pilot → first production) and hands-on plant or co-manufacturer support; ingredient-supplier or contract- manufacturing background is a strong plus.
  • Working knowledge of blending and processing equipment (paddle blenders, V- blenders, ribbon blenders, augers, packaging lines) across food, beverage, or nutritional products.
  • Direct experience with GFSI audits (SQF, BRC) and food safety/quality documentation, ideally from both the auditee and technical-support sides, comfortable advising the site-facing quality team rather than owning the day-to-day audit relationship.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust-based relationships with manufacturing partners and to have direct, difficult conversations when needed.
  • Comfortable with variable travel to assigned manufacturing sites, planned around commercialization and launch milestones rather than as the primary on-call, short-notice responder.

WHAT WE OFFER

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role

The Platform API team defines the cross-platform APIs and abstractions that give the CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor a consistent programming interface across Windows, Linux, and macOS. These APIs sit at the boundary between feature code and OS-specific implementations and the quality of these abstractions directly shapes how fast and safely sensor development can move across the organization. The team is also responsible for shared platform code, with a clear distinction between platform-agnostic interfaces and per-platform implementation.. A central workstream is building shared on-sensor ML inference infrastructure: a cross-language runtime that enables any sensor component to execute ML models with hardware acceleration across all platforms.

This is a systems software role. You'll work close to the OS across multiple platforms, reason carefully about correctness and performance under real-world load, and hold a high engineering bar in a codebase where reliability is non-negotiable. You will work cross-functionally with peer engineers across Mac, Linux, Windows, and many other teams inside and outside your core organization in a varied environment.

What You're Stepping Into

You're stepping into a team with established component ownership and a charter that is actively expanding. The engineering spans cross-platform correctness, performance-sensitive code paths, and shared platform infrastructure where a defect could propagate across every consumer simultaneously. You'll work alongside engineers who hold a high reliability bar for software that runs continuously on endpoints at global scale. If you want to build foundational software that runs at global scale and has a direct impact on security outcomes, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Design and implement cross-platform API components and abstractions; own features from design through delivery across Windows, Linux, and macOS

  • Contribute to shared on-sensor ML inference infrastructure: build components of the API layer, client library, sandboxed inference service, and test harness that make ML model deployment a first-class capability in the sensor

  • Reason carefully about API contracts: interface clarity, ABI stability, backward compatibility, and the downstream cost of breaking changes across a large consuming codebase

  • Work directly with Mac, Linux, and Windows sensor teams to understand their requirements and evolve the API surface to meet them

  • Participate in design and code reviews; contribute substantive technical feedback that improves the quality of what ships

  • Investigate failures and troubleshoot issues that cross the API or inference boundary; build your knowledge of how platform abstractions interact with OS-specific behavior

  • Investigate and resolve production incidents; build your understanding of failure modes across the platform

  • Champion improvements in end-to-end testing and validation for components with strict correctness and reliability requirements

What You'll Need

  • Strong foundation in systems software engineering; hands-on experience in C and C++ in a low-level systems context

  • Cross-platform exposure across Windows, Linux, and/or macOS; ability to reason about portability, behavioral consistency, and platform-specific constraints

  • Solid API design instincts: clear interface contracts, ABI stability considerations, managing change with component versioning and bundling

  • Ability to own ambiguous technical problems and drive them to clean resolution

  • Collaborative and clear communicator that can work effectively across teams and can convey technical tradeoffs

  • Intellectual curiosity and the drive to deeply understand unfamiliar systems before changing them

  • Strong engineering fundamentals: testable, reviewable code; careful about edge cases; high personal bar

  • Ability and willingness to travel occasionally for team offsites and in-person meetings

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points

  • Background in endpoint security, EDR, kernel-adjacent software, or sensor platform engineering

  • Experience with ML inference runtimes or model execution frameworks (ONNX, CoreML, OpenVINO); familiarity with how inference pipelines are structured is a plus

  • Experience with out-of-process architecture patterns: sandboxed service isolation or inter-process communication at low latency

  • Experience designing or maintaining cross-platform code or shared API layers consumed by multiple teams

  • Open source contributions, technical writing, or a visible engineering presence through conference talks or published work

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards

  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Paid parental and adoption leaves

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

raw.description:
A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoaEngenheiro de Software AI-Native (Dominio em Python),para se juntar a nossa equipe dinâmica e atuar em parceria com a maior construtora da América Latina, que ao longo de sua existência, sempre esteve sintonizada com o mercado e as melhores práticas, além de priorizar sempre as necessidades de seus clientes.Éuma empresa que está em constante movimento, se reinventando a cada dia para oferecer soluções de moradia para todas as gerações.

Sobre o Time:

Nosso time é o motor da transformação digital e o principal responsável pela disseminação do uso de Inteligência Artificial em toda a companhia. Além da governança técnica (Python e Power BI), lideramos o desenvolvimento de soluções avançadas de GenAI e Low Code (Power Platform e n8n), entregando desde diversos assistentes conversacionais integrados ao WhatsApp até agentes autônomos executores de tarefas, além de inúmeras outras ferramentas.

Atuamos de forma transversal: recebemos demandas e desafios de todas as áreas de negócio e da TI, e nossa missão não é apenas solucionar problemas, mas sim transformar necessidades pontuais em produtos escaláveis. Gerimos uma plataforma interna de criação de assistentes virtuais e ferramentas que democratizam o uso da IA para milhares de colaboradores. Se você gosta de transformar uma dor operacional em uma solução que impacta milhares de pessoas, aqui é o seu lugar.

Principais atividades

  • Produzir software de forma AI-native: conduzir agentes e LLMs a partir de especificações, mantendo responsabilidade técnica integral pelo resultado. Você especifica, orquestra, revisa e responde pelo código. A IA executa;
  • Conduzir o ciclo de Spec-Driven Development: transformar requisitos em especificações executáveis e artefatos de contexto (ex.: /specify, /plan) que servem de contrato para o trabalho humano e para os agentes.
  • Calibrar a autonomia progressiva da IA conforme risco e maturidade do contexto: saber quando aceitar a geração autônoma e quando intervir manualmente, sem perder o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Participar do rito de Pull Request Aumentado, revisando não apenas sintaxe, mas intencionalidade: aderência aos critérios de aceite, decisões técnicas e impacto funcional — inclusive sobre código gerado por agentes, não só por humanos.
  • Contribuir para a camada de conhecimento e os contextos reutilizáveis (skills, padrões, decisões arquiteturais, conectores/MCPs) que tornam os agentes consistentes e confiáveis no domínio da MRV.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia para entregar código limpo, testável e sustentável, em sistemas de diferentes características (monolitos e/ou distribuídos), com foco em valor de negócio e ritmo sustentável.
  • Contribuir com testes automatizados, observabilidade — inclusive sobre a qualidade e o custo do output de IA — e práticas que reduzam retrabalho e débito técnico.
  • Atuar em times colaborativos guiados por valor, usando metodologias ágeis e práticas como code review, pair e mob programming, compartilhando aprendizados e sendo mentorado(a) por profissionais mais experientes.

Conhecimento técnico (mandatório)

  • Pelo menos 3 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento de software, com domínio forte em Python e capacidade comprovada de transitar pelas demais com apoio de IA. Valorizamos experiência Fullstack.
  • Spec-Driven Development como competência central: escrever especificações não ambíguas, decompor em planos verificáveis e definir critérios de aceite que funcionem como contrato para humanos e agentes (ex.: /specify, /plan).
  • Engenharia de Contexto: construção e gestão de contexto para LLMs — instruções, restrições, exemplos, seleção de ferramentas/MCPs e controle da janela de contexto.
  • Uso de IA Generativa e ferramentas agentivas aplicado ao desenvolvimento, com responsabilidade, senso crítico e validação humana sistemática.
  • Leitura crítica de código que você não escreveu: avaliar, validar e corrigir output de IA e de terceiros com a mesma profundidade do próprio código.
  • Habilidade para escrever código de alta qualidade, bem organizado e testável, com domínio de OO e/ou bons princípios de design.
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários e/ou de integração).
  • Uso de Git para versionamento e colaboração via Pull Requests.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados SQL e fundamentos de modelagem de dados.
  • Vivência com práticas ágeis (Scrum, Kanban ou XP).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prática com orquestração de agentes e MCPs/conectores (composição de ferramentas, automação de fluxos com IA).
  • Familiaridade com avaliação e observabilidade de output de IA (medir qualidade, regressões, custo de tokens) e com arquiteturas model-agnostic.
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas, microsserviços ou mensageria.
  • Vivência com CI/CD, automação de build e release.
  • Conhecimento em nuvem e/ou contêineres (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experiência com frameworks de GenAI como LlamaIndex e LangChain.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de RAG, Tools e MCP.
  • Experiência com Streamlit para front-end.
  • Experiência com processos Assíncronos, Paralelos e Filas.
  • Manipulação de dados com Pandas.
  • Vivência com ferramentas Low Code (principalmente N8N).
  • Experiência com automação para SAP HANA.
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD.
  • Familiaridade com GCP e/ou Azure DevOps.

Soft skills e comportamentos

  • Clareza de escrita e de especificação como skill de primeira ordem: no modelo AI-native, especificar bem é programar. Quem especifica mal, gera mal.
  • Pensamento crítico e ceticismo técnico: não confiar cegamente em soluções automáticas, especialmente as geradas por IA.
  • Conforto com ambiguidade e com delegar: soltar o controle do "como" mantendo o controle do "o quê" e do "porquê".
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade para buscar soluções sem depender de direcionamento constante.
  • Comunicação clara para discutir requisitos, decisões técnicas e trade-offs.
  • Colaboração e respeito ao time, valorizando o aprendizado coletivo.
  • Adaptabilidade em um ambiente de rápida evolução tecnológica.
  • Importa-se genuinamente com o sucesso do produto e do time.
  • Assume responsabilidades mesmo quando não são formalmente atribuídas.
  • Aprende com erros, celebra conquistas coletivas e se posiciona com coragem diante de decisões difíceis.
