Position Overview

The Autodesk Talent organization is seeking a Process Optimization Manager to lead Talent-wide process standardization initiatives including technology and AI adoption, enablement readiness, and measurable value realization across Talent workflows. Reporting to the Talent Chief of Staff, you will work across the Talent organization—including talent acquisition, talent development, and global mobility—and partner closely with People Insights & Solution Design (PISD), Enterprise Systems (ESE), Talent Operations, Trust, Privacy, Procurement, Finance, and functional owners. This role will ensure that our processes support our global Talent strategy at scale and that tools and AI-enabled capabilities are embedded into how work gets done and continually optimized to improve efficiency, quality, and the experience of candidates, employees, managers, and Talent practitioners.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own Talent-wide process optimization and standardization, with cross-Talent accountability where workflows, tools, data, or user experiences intersect

  • Assess current-state processes, identify friction, duplication, control gaps, and improvement opportunities, and design scalable future-state workflows, standards, handoffs, and operating practices

  • Translate Talent business needs into clear requirements, use cases, process impacts, and adoption priorities for PISD, ESE, vendors, and other delivery partners; provide business-side feedback on technology roadmaps and technical delivery

  • Establish process documentation standards and maintain an accessible source of truth for approved workflows, roles, decision rights, controls, and standard use cases

  • Own tool engagement and adoption routines, including usage expectations, stakeholder reinforcement, feedback loops, and actions informed by utilization data

  • Define and track value-realization measures including adoption, efficiency, quality, process adherence, user experience, and business impact

  • Partner with People Analytics, PISD, and tool owners to obtain and interpret usage and process data, identify underutilization, or experience gaps, and recommend corrective actions

  • Drive responsible adoption of AI-enabled ways of working within Talent processes, aligned to the central PPL AI roadmap, enterprise governance, privacy, security, and appropriate use of employee and candidate data

  • Define governance model for tools, including user eligibility, approval paths, onboarding and offboarding standards, periodic reviews, and audit requirements, coordinate with system administrators, Talent Operations and Trust teams

  • Coordinate business inputs for privacy impact assessments, data retention and deletion processes, procurement activities, purchase orders, vendor renewals, and deprecation decisions

  • Partner with enablement, change management, and communications teams to translate process and tool standards into launch readiness, training, playbooks, communications, reinforcement, and sustained behavior change

  • Represent the voice of candidates, employees, managers, recruiters, and Talent practitioners to improve end-to-end experiences and reduce friction across processes and handoffs

  • Stay current on process excellence, HR technology, AI adoption, change enablement, and employee experience practices to inform continuous improvement and innovation

  • Global travel may be required

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years of experience in process optimization, business operations, operational excellence, change enablement, HR or Talent operations, technology adoption, or related discipline in a complex enterprise environment

  • Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end process improvement and standardization initiatives across multiple functions, regions, or stakeholder groups

  • Strong ability to map current-state and future-state processes, clarify roles and decision rights, identify root causes, and translate findings into scalable operating standards

  • Experience driving adoption and measurable value from enterprise technology, digital tools, automation, or AI-enabled workflows

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use operational, usage, and experience data to identify opportunities, prioritize actions, and measure outcomes

  • Experience translating business needs into clear requirements, use cases, process impacts, and implementation or enablement needs for technical, data, and vendor partners

  • Working knowledge of change management and enablement practices, including stakeholder analysis, readiness, communications, training, reinforcement, and feedback loops

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and levels without direct authority

  • Ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, establish governance, and drive clarity and follow-through in a global, matrixed organization

  • Familiarity with data privacy, access controls, records retention, security, and responsible AI considerations relevant to employee and candidate processes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in business, Human Resources, Organizational Development, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Experience in Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, onboarding, global mobility, or broader HR operations

  • Experience with enterprise HR and Talent platforms, such as Workday, Eightfold, SAP SuccessFactors, learning management systems, talent marketplaces, recruiting technologies, or workforce intelligence tools

  • Experience applying Agile to process and optimization and other improvement practices like Lean, Six Sigma, business process management, service design, or human-centered design methods

  • Experience defining adoption, utilization, process adherence, efficiency, quality, and value-realization metrics for technology or process investments

  • Experience identifying, implementing, or scaling AI, automation, copilots, agents, or conversational interfaces within HR or Talent workflows

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

About the role

Broker and brokerage partnerships are a strategic focus for Zillow and one of the biggest growth opportunities in residential real estate. Brokers sit at a critical distribution level, and Zillow is investing in new products and programs to unlock the full potential of these partnerships. Robust measurement and strategic guidance will power what comes next: understanding where value is created, what's working, and where to invest.

The Business Data team is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to serve as a core analytics lead for Zillow's broker data products, measurement strategy, and enterprise ROI, turning on the lights to the depth and value of broker relationships across the Zillow Group ecosystem. You will lead the design of broker-level success metrics and the causal inference frameworks that measure product, go-to-market, and business impact at the enterprise level, and build the trusted, scalable analytical foundations that turn complex data into insights decision-makers act on. The data products you build won't just inform internal decisions; they will help Zillow deliver more value to broker partners and their customers. This is a newly formed pod with significant company investment and executive visibility: few roles offer this much influence over how a strategic priority is measured, understood, and grown.

This work is highly visible to senior leadership, and your insights will directly shape how Zillow invests in one of its biggest strategic areas. For a data scientist ready to grow, this is a rare opportunity to build a high-visibility charter from the ground up, with a clear runway to expand your scope, influence senior leaders, and sharpen your craft alongside a broad data organization working across AI-enabled analytics, data products, and measurement. You will see your work show up quickly in decisions, product direction, and the value Zillow delivers to its partners.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the high-context analytics owner for broker data products and go-to-market, establishing durable methodology and metric standards

  • Independently scope and deliver end-to-end measurement and data science projects, from problem framing through methodology design, validation, and productionization

  • Lead the design of broker-level success metrics and causal inference frameworks (e.g., matching, difference-in-differences) that quantify the impact of products, features, and go-to-market initiatives at the enterprise level

  • Partner with Product Managers and go-to-market teams to design, deploy, and execute measurement roadmaps, guiding data product development from problem definition through measurement and iteration

  • Conduct analytical deep dives and opportunity sizing to inform product and go-to-market roadmaps; Provide data-driven recommendations to senior leadership, clearly communicating trade-offs, assumptions, and impact

  • Build reliable, scalable analytical pipelines, scheduled jobs, and reusable data products that scale insights and demonstrate product value to partners and customers; Leverage AI-assisted analytics workflows to scale your impact, while designing core analytical logic in deterministic, verifiable ways

  • Support externally facing product value narratives with rigorous, defensible methodology

Scope & impact

  • Pioneering Senior Data Scientist at the center of Zillow's broker data product and go-to-market strategy, with executive visibility and sponsorship

  • Owns broker measurement and data product analytics end to end, delivering solutions with limited oversight

  • Shapes the metrics, measurement approaches, and methodology standards that make broker data products trusted and actionable across the org

  • Balances speed and rigor, making sound trade-offs in measurement, analysis, and stakeholder alignment

  • Individual contributor role with no direct reports, working within a broad data organization that creates meaningful opportunities for cross-domain learning and influence

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $148,600.00 - $237,400.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $141,200.00 - $225,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You are energized by ambiguous, high-impact problems and love turning complex data into decisions people trust. You hold a high bar for analytical rigor, enjoy partnering across functions, and take pride in seeing your insights change what a business does. You appreciate the unique challenges of building and measuring B2B products and go-to-market.

Additionally, we expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, or a related quantitative field; a Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in statistics or a similar quantitative discipline is preferred

  • Strong foundation in statistics, causal inference, and experimentation (A/B testing), with high analytical rigor and demonstrated ability to design clear, durable metrics and assess product or go-to-market impact from definition through decision-making

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience partnering with Product Managers, engineers, and go-to-market teams, influencing decisions, and communicating complex findings to technical and non-technical audiences; B2B product and business strategy experience are a plus

  • Strong SQL and Python skills, including the ability to develop and maintain complex query logic; comfortable working with large datasets in modern data platforms (e.g., Spark, Databricks)

  • Effective at leveraging AI tools in day-to-day analytical work while maintaining high rigor

  • Experience with product analytics at a senior level, including measurement, experimentation, clickstream and segment analysis, and influencing decisions with data; experience building end-to-end predictive ML models is a strong plus

  • Experience building reliable, scalable analytical pipelines and scheduled data jobs, or contributing to data and analytics platform development, is a plus

  • Ability to work independently in ambiguous spaces as a self-starting, end-to-end owner; data visualization experience (e.g., Tableau) is preferred but not required

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

About Wellspring

Wellspring Worldwide, Inc. is a leading provider of web-based software systems for managing research, technology commercialization, and innovation operations for universities, companies, government agencies, and independent labs. Founded in 2003, Wellspring has grown to serve over 500 organizations globally, including Fortune 500 companies, SMEs, hospitals, and universities. The company’s flagship products—Sophia, Flintbox, and Zeto—enable organizations to manage the entire innovation lifecycle, from discovery and IP management to commercialization and knowledge transfer.

***You MUST be authorized to work in the United Kingdom to qualify for this role and hold ***

General Summary

Wellspring seeks a diligent and client focused professional to join our team as an Implementation Specialist for supporting our client implementation process. Your main responsibility will be to configuration of our software system and transitioning of client data during our enterprise software implementations. You will also collaborate with clients, business development and project managers during each phase from project planning to execution to system delivery. This position is ideal for people who want to provide solutions to client business process that will impact the world through innovation.

Job Description
As an Implementation Project Manager, you will lead the interactions with clients and work with internal staff in executing successful implementations of our technology transfer software. This role demands ability to manage multiple projects at the same time and experience with Salesforce systems. The RIGHT candidate should have the ability to manage configurations, interpret client requests for workflows or configurations. This role also requires strong organizational skills, technical proficiency, and attention to detail. You will assist in data migration, troubleshooting, and configuring to meet client needs.

Responsibilities

  • Perform basic Salesforce configurations such as permission, fields, and data importing.
  • Manage data migration processes with internal teams.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to gather requirements and translate them into solutions.
  • Troubleshoot software configuration and data reconciliation-related issues.
  • Track project management tasks, including timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder communication.
  • Provide training and documentation to clients on software functionality.

Requirements

  • Salesforce experience, including configurations, customization, and training (certifications like Salesforce Administrator preferred).
  • Project Management background preferred
    (PMP certifications, etc.)
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • 2-4 years of experience as a solution consultant, data analyst or leading enterprise software implementations.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Beginner to intermediate Excel knowledge.
  • Industry experience in B2B software.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher preferred.
  • Background in providing solutions for academic institutions, research hospitals, or industrial R&D is preferred.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

Join the CrowdStrike mission to stop breaches as a technical expert working with our largest and most strategic partners.

Ideal candidates have strong experience in architecting and enabling security solutions with major Crowdstrike partners, transforming how they deliver cybersecurity to their customers. Working closely with our Alliance Managers, you'll shape how global partners build and deliver next-generation security services using CrowdStrike's advanced technology.

As a Solution Architect, you will be part of the team revolutionizing the cybersecurity landscape through CrowdStrike's AI-Native Security Platform. Working with the world's leading technology partners, your expertise will directly influence how major global partners protect millions of endpoints and help organizations worldwide secure their customers.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect and design security services with partners, leveraging CrowdStrike's Falcon platform capabilities – focused on Cloud Security and complex CI/CD pipelines

  • Drive platform adoption strategy, helping partners build comprehensive security offerings

  • Support technical GTM strategy and growth with assigned focus partners, including deep engagement with the tech integration ecosystem

  • Develop and execute long-term enablement plans supporting go-to-market initiatives, with a train-the-trainer mindset and pipeline-driven business orientation

  • Build and maintain relationships with partner technical and sales leadership teams across Endpoint, Cloud, Identity, AIDR, Data Protection & NG-SIEM

  • Enabling partners in embedding the Falcon Platform within their managed services portfolio, including deployments on EU Sovereign Cloud infrastructure

  • Design technical solutions that integrate CrowdStrike into partners' existing security services and complex hyperscaler environments, including extensive Kubernetes deployments and CNAPP frameworks

  • Create and deliver technical training programs enabling partners to demo, deploy, and support CrowdStrike solutions focused on Cloud Security, ASPM, CSPM & Workload protection

  • Lead partners to achieve technical self-sufficiency in service delivery and platform implementation

  • Enable partners on POC/POV best practices and provide competitive positioning guidance against key vendors

  • Participate in quarterly business reviews and technical planning sessions

  • Drive technical partner programs including Falcon Champions

  • Bridge communication between partners and CrowdStrike technical teams

  • Speaking on Crowdstrike conferences and partner events as a technical expert

  • Travel up to 50% to engage with customers and internal teams

What You'll Need:

  • Proven track record (10+ years) in Technical Consulting, Solution Architecture & Technical Presales with leading Cybersecurity vendors

  • Strong background in Cloud security and zero-trust architectures

  • Hands-on experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI) and complex hyperscaler environments, including CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes deployments

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code engines and automated Cloud configuration tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)

  • Knowledge of sovereign Cloud Platform Providers and their technology

  • Experience in designing and implementing security solutions at enterprise scale

  • Working knowledge of SIEM/XDR & data pipeline solutions and SOC operations

  • Technical expertise in endpoint protection, identity management, and cloud workload security, including CNAPP solutions

  • Strong competitive intelligence with the ability to position CrowdStrike's Falcon Cloud Security as the preferred solution

  • Experience with API integration and workflow automation capabilities

About the role

The Growth Marketing team at JustGiving is responsible for driving acquisition and loyalty growth. We help more people and charities fundraise online, and help them raise more money.

We're looking for a confident, commercially minded Website Content Manager to help shape and improve the marketing content experience across our website.

This is a hands-on role for someone ready to take the next step in their digital content career. You'll combine strong website management expertise with excellent copywriting skills, taking ownership of content within our CMS and helping ensure our marketing-owned website experiences are clear, engaging, accessible and effective.

You'll be responsible for managing and optimising landing pages, information pages and key customer journeys, while helping establish strong content governance and publishing standards across marketing-managed content.

Working alongside our B2B content specialist, who focuses primarily on creating content for our charity audience, you'll focus predominantly on consumer audiences, including fundraisers and donors. You'll act as a key steward of content quality, user experience and conversion across marketing-owned website content, helping ensure customers can easily find information and take action.

Reporting to the Head of CRM & Digital, you'll bring specialist expertise in CMS management, content governance, information architecture, UX content and conversion-focused copywriting. You'll be the team's go-to expert on how website content should be structured, managed and optimised to support growth.

Key responsibilities:

CMS Management & Content Governance

  • Own day-to-day management of marketing-owned website content within our CMS.
  • Build, publish and maintain landing pages, information pages and campaign content.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for content governance, page structure and publishing best practice across marketing-managed website experiences.
  • Ensure content remains accurate, up to date, accessible and aligned with brand standards.
  • Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, duplicated or underperforming content.
  • Work closely with our B2B content specialist to ensure a coherent experience across B2B and B2C audiences.
  • Identify opportunities to improve navigation, page structure and customer journeys within marketing-owned content areas.

Website Copywriting & Content Optimisation

  • Write, edit and optimise high-performing website copy that drives clarity, engagement and conversion.
  • Create compelling landing pages and campaign experiences that support acquisition, activation and fundraising goals.
  • Translate complex information into simple, customer-friendly content.
  • Maintain consistency of tone of voice, messaging and brand standards across website content.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate content creation, optimisation and ideation while maintaining strong editorial judgement.
  • Ensure content is accessible, inclusive and easy to understand for a broad range of audiences.

User Experience, CRO & Performance

  • Apply UX writing and information architecture principles to improve website journeys.
  • Work closely with Search, Social, CRM and Design teams to optimise website performance.
  • Support acquisition growth by creating effective content experiences across paid media, SEO and GEO channels.
  • Bring a test-and-learn mindset to continuously improve website content performance.
  • Use analytics, user research and behavioural insights to identify opportunities for improvement.

Skills & Experience:

Essential

  • Experience managing website content through a CMS (ideally WordPress or similar CMS platforms).
  • Strong understanding of content governance, publishing workflows and website content operations.
  • Excellent copywriting, editing and proofreading skills.
  • Experience creating landing pages and conversion-focused website content.
  • Strong understanding of information architecture and digital content best practice.
  • Experience using analytics and customer insight to improve content performance.
  • Working knowledge of SEO, GEO and CRO principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex information into clear, engaging customer content.
  • Strong project management, organisation and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and priorities.

Desirable

  • Experience in online fundraising, charities, non-profit organisations or mission-led businesses.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design principles.
  • Experience working alongside CRM, acquisition or lifecycle marketing teams.
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly to support content workflows and optimisation.

What You'll Bring:

  • A passion for creating exceptional digital experiences.
  • Strong editorial judgement and attention to detail.
  • Confidence managing website content and influencing how it is structured, governed and improved.
  • A balance of creativity, customer empathy and commercial thinking.
  • Curiosity to test, learn and continuously improve.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused mindset.
  • Confidence challenging existing approaches and recommending better ways of working.
  • The ambition to become a recognised website content expert within the organisation.

Success in this role

You'll be successful if you can:

  • Maintain a high-quality, well-governed marketing content estate within our CMS.
  • Create landing pages and content experiences that support growth and conversion.
  • Improve how content is organised, governed and maintained.
  • Help customers find information more easily and complete key actions.
  • Build strong partnerships across Marketing, Product, Design and agency teams.
  • Bring specialist website content expertise that elevates the effectiveness of our digital experiences.

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

Help us protect the Security Cloud from the most advanced threats! CrowdStrike's Product Security team breaks the mold of traditional security teams and focuses on active threats to CrowdStrike's products and platform. As a Security Engineer III on Product Security Architecture, you will serve as a subject matter expert and trusted security partner across our product and engineering organizations.

This isn't a role dedicated to managing firewall rules or security group configurations. You will develop deep expertise across our security cloud — spanning public cloud and physical data centers — to identify security gaps, reduce attack surface, and architect new secure architectural patterns that scale with our business. Operating with full independence on poorly-understood and ambiguous problems, you will drive medium-to-long-term strategic direction for network security across the product group, while mentoring and multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around you.

This is a highly dynamic, hands-on role that requires both deep technical depth and the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives with broad organizational impact.

What You'll Do:

Network & Cloud Security Architecture & Engineering

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of CrowdStrike's hybrid networks spanning public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and physical data centers, continuously assessing attack surface and identifying security gaps.

  • Design and architect new network connection patterns and zone segmentation strategies that reduce risk while enabling product scalability.

  • Build scalable monitoring, alerting, and automation solutions targeting security risks across a fast-moving, dynamic environment.

  • Lead threat modeling efforts focused on secure architecture, data flows, and connectivity patterns across platform services.

  • Evaluate current threat landscape and business priorities to effectively sequence and drive the highest-impact security improvements.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Ability to deliver on less-defined tasks in their area of expertise, given clear requirements

  • Contribute to the near to medium-term strategic direction for network & cloud infrastructure security; proactively identify areas of greatest need and developing actionable plans to address them.

  • Provide architectural and design expertise that accounts for the broader platform picture, not just point-in-time solutions.

  • Ability to become a SME for the team in the area of cloud security controls

  • Communicate technical decision through design docs, tech talks, and wiki

Cross-Team Partnership & Collaboration

  • Partner closely with product engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams to understand scaling requirements & translate them into secure-by-design architecture patterns.

  • Work across organizational boundaries to facilitate alignment on security requirements, driving consensus on complex and ambiguous problems.

  • Clearly communicate decisions and architectural direction to both technical and non-technical stakeholders once alignment is reached.

  • Serve as a role model for security culture and best practices within your functional area.

Mentorship & Talent Development

  • Multiply the effectiveness of the broader team by facilitating cross-team knowledge sharing and collaboration.

  • Be a valued team resource for your area of expertise and someone teammates seek out to work with.

  • Mentor junior ICs or interns via pairing, design reviews, and code reviews.

What You'll Need:

  • Deep networking expertise across hybrid environments — public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and physical data center networking — including routing, segmentation, zone design, and traffic inspection architectures.

  • Strong cloud security knowledge and experience identity gaps in coverage and controls across a hybrid cloud environment.

  • Solid experience identifying network security gaps and designing scalable, secure connection patterns in SaaS or cloud-native product environments.

  • Strong protocol knowledge including TCP/IP, HTTP/S, DNS, TLS, and applied cryptography.

  • Prior exposure to leveraging AI to improve the effectiveness of the team’s capabilities.

  • Experience building scalable monitoring, alerting, and automation solutions for network security use cases.

  • Scripting and automation capabilities in Python, Go, shell, or equivalent languages.

  • Experience working with teams that engineer and bring products to market in fast-paced, forward-looking environments.

  • Understanding of security architecture principles across the SDLC.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently on broad problems and drive them to resolution.

  • Excellent communication skills — able to participate in technical debates, build consensus, and clearly articulate complex security concepts to varied audiences.

  • A combination of confidence, independence, clear thinking, and a collaborative mindset.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with GCP’s security controls.

  • Experience with IaaS/PaaS networking constructs (VPCs, transit gateways, private endpoints, service meshes, etc.)

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust network architecture principles and implementation patterns.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline security and operational systems.

  • Experience building solutions leveraging AI’s capabilities.

  • Understanding of compliance requirements and evidence collection in a regulated SaaS environment.

  • Prior experience in a formal mentorship capacity.

Education:

We are seeking an experiencedShort Sale Expertto join our Sell to Rent team, helping homeowners navigate difficult financial situations when they owe more on their mortgage than their property is worth. Homeowner Consultation & Advisory

  • Conduct discovery calls to understand homeowner financial situations and property conditions.

Pipeline & Performance Management

  • 3+ years of short sale experience in U.S. residential real estate.

    • Short sale process and lender negotiations

    • Loss mitigation

    • Foreclosure timelines

    • Mortgage servicing

    • Negative equity situations

    • Title and lien resolution

    • Distressed real estate transactions

  • Experience working with distressed homeowners and sensitive financial situations.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple files simultaneously.

  • Experience using CRM systems and transaction management platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in distressed property acquisition, or foreclosure prevention.

  • Knowledge of investor-backed residential real estate models.

Key Success Metrics

  • Short sale approval rate

  • Time to approval/closing

  • File progression and pipeline management

  • Customer satisfaction and homeowner experience

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Empathetic and consultative with homeowners in distress

  • Strong negotiator with lenders and servicing departments

  • Highly organized and process-driven

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, high-volume environments

Bureau Veritas is seeking an experienced Pre-Construction Project Manager to support the development and delivery of ground-up, multi-site commercial projects throughout California, with a focus on automotive service, retail, and other customer-facing facilities. This is a REMOTE role.

This is a pre-construction-focused position for a project manager who understands how to move a project from initial planning through design, permitting, bidding, and construction readiness.

The ideal candidate has significant experience with new-build projects and a strong working knowledge of how California jurisdictions operate, including local permitting processes, plan review, building departments, municipal requirements, and agency coordination.

You will work closely with clients, architects, engineers, contractors, consultants, and local jurisdictions to identify issues early, keep projects moving, and ensure each project is fully prepared for construction.

This is a remote position.

Job Description

We're looking for a highly trusted, detail-obsessed professional to build and run a controlled archive and knowledge-review system for our organization. You'll decide what information gets preserved, how it's tracked, and what's ready to enter our governed knowledge environment — using approved AI tools to move faster, but never skipping your own judgment call.

This is a low-hours, fractional engagement (up to 8 hours/week) structured as an 8-week pilot — a great fit for an experienced records or compliance professional looking for flexible contract work.

What You'll Own

  • Receive, preserve, and track custody of authorized records and source files

  • Review incoming material for sensitivity, ownership, and admission eligibility

  • Use AI tools to speed up inventory and classification — then personally verify every material decision

  • Flag missing, corrupted, or high-risk material immediately

  • Deliver a short weekly report on work completed, backlog, and risks


Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Background in records management, information governance, compliance, audit, or legal ops

  • Rock-solid discretion with highly confidential information

  • Comfortable using AI tools — with the judgment to catch when they're wrong

  • Clear written communicator who escalates uncertainty instead of guessing

Bonus Points

  • Experience standing up a new archive or governance function from scratch

  • Familiarity with legal hold, privacy, or cybersecurity practices

  • Experience designing human review controls around AI-assisted work

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • Like being the last line of defense before information becomes "official"

  • Have zero tolerance for sloppy records or unverified assumptions

  • Want meaningful contract work without a full-time commitment


Benefits

Benefits

  • HMO (health insurance)

  • Work from anywhere

  • Opportunities for promotion

This role operates primarily on a remote working arrangement that will require little to no travel into our Coventry head office or various UK campuses. Our working model arrangements are a non-contractual benefit so please note that an Arden work location is added to our employment contracts.

About Arden University:

We are an aspirational and multi-award-winning university, delivering rapid growth with ambitious plans to disrupt the HE sector through our passion for innovation and digital education. Our vision is to become the first-choice university for career-focused lifelong learners worldwide, ensuring that everyone, everywhere can access higher education.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines, forge worldwide partnerships, and expand our locations.

About our Faculty:

The Faculty of Business and Innovation brings together a diverse portfolio of programmes designed to equip students with the knowledge, skills, and mindset needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving global landscape. With a strong focus on practical, industry-informed learning, the Faculty works closely with employers and partners to ensure its teaching remains relevant, forward-thinking, and impactful.

Supporting multiple Schools and academic teams, the Faculty operates in a dynamic and collaborative environment where innovation, digital capability, and continuous improvement are central to its approach. Professional services colleagues play a vital role in enabling the delivery of academic priorities, ensuring smooth operations, and enhancing the overall student and staff experience.

About the Opportunity:

As an Academic Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the effective delivery of academic activity within the Faculty of Business and Innovation. Working closely with academic leaders and stakeholders, you will provide high-quality administrative support to a designated School while collaborating across the wider Faculty to ensure consistency and efficiency in processes.

You will be responsible for coordinating a range of activities, managing competing priorities, and supporting the delivery of academic projects and initiatives. This is a fast-paced and varied role, requiring strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to respond positively to changing demands. Using a range of digital tools, you will help ensure the smooth day-to-day operation of the School, contributing to a positive and collaborative working environment and the successful delivery of the Faculty’s objectives.

About You:

Essential Skills / Experience:

  • Proven experience providing administrative support within a professional environment, including supporting senior stakeholders

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively under pressure

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently with a wide range of stakeholders

  • High level of attention to detail and a methodical approach to work, with the ability to work independently

  • Proactive problem-solving skills, with the confidence to use initiative and improve processes where appropriate

  • Experience of coordinating meetings and events, including scheduling, minute-taking, and managing documentation

  • Ability to monitor progress, follow up on actions, and manage data effectively

  • Good understanding of financial administration processes, including raising purchase orders and checking data accuracy

  • Experience of working with sensitive information and a strong understanding of data protection requirements (e.g. GDPR)

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 tools, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

Desirable Skills / Experience

  • Experience of working in a similar role in a higher education/other educational institutions

  • Knowledge of key current issues within the HE sector.

  • Experience in SharePoint management as well as knowledge around VLE platforms.

Why Arden:

At Arden, you will become a part of a passionate and dedicated team who are committed to removing unnecessary barriers to learning and making education more accessible. Our people work hard to ensure our students journeys are the best they can possibly be, as such we want to reward our people with fantastic benefits. Employees benefit from:

  • 30 days holiday + bank holidays on-top, and even a Christmas closure!

  • A generous Aviva pension plan, company contributions starting from 7%

  • BUPA Cash Plan

  • Private Medical Insurance coverage (applies to certain job roles)

  • Access to Perkbox benefits

  • Study any Arden course for free, with a discount for all family and friends

  • Plus, other excellent benefits

  • Our ‘Golden Ticket’ which allows you to gift anyone in your life a free Arden education

Our Values:

Stand out, Progressive, Accessible, Resourceful, Kindness, reflect who we are as an institution, a team and as individuals. If they also reflect you and you are excited by the chance to be the driving, creative force within a growing business, we want to hear from you.

There has never been a more exciting time to join Arden University, as we expand into new disciplines and locations.

Closing Date:6th Sept

We reserve the right to close this vacancy before the specified closing date should we receive sufficient applications or in order to respond to business needs. In order to avoid missing an opportunity to apply please submit your application as early as possible.

If you are a current Arden student or have an upcoming course with us, you are not eligible to apply for Student Experience roles due to a conflict of interest related to system access.

Equity, Diversity & Inclusion:

Arden University is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer. This means that if you have a disability, as defined by the Disability Equality Act 2010, you may be guaranteed an interview if you meet the essential criteria for the role.

If you wish to be considered under this scheme, you can indicate via the application form below. By doing so, you are also consenting for this information to be shared with the hiring team. For more details on what qualifies as a disability under the Disability Equality Act 2010, please refer to the guidance here.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. Therefore, we make sure that our recruitment and selection processes never discriminate based upon people's age, disability, gender, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or other personal circumstances, and actively welcome applications from all groups.

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Compliance Specialist II to join our team! The Compliance Specialist II conducts compliance monitoring, audits, and investigations to ensure adherence to regulatory and contractual requirements. The role evaluates findings, determines appropriate corrective actions, and coordinates resolution activities to address non-compliance and strengthen program integrity.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Process assigned compliance cases from intake through resolution.
  • Conduct compliance audits and monitoring activities for internal stakeholders, providers, and vendors.
  • Investigate allegations of non-compliance.
  • Evaluate case findings and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Monitor implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and six (6) years of experience with mental health, substance use, developmental disabilities, and/or co-occurring disorders populations or field; OR
  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of experience with mental health, substance use, developmental disabilities, and/or co-occurring disorders populations or field; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of experience with mental health, substance use, developmental disabilities, and/or co-occurring disorders populations or field; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Experience in any of the following areas would be valuable for this employee: Public speaking, mediation and/or problem resolution, group facilitation, advocacy, regulations compliance, and project management.
  • CHC, AFHI, CFE, and fully licensed in the State of NC - LCMHC, LMFT, LCWS, LCAS, or RN.

Deadline for Application: 09/01/2026

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

Who we are:

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. We equip universities and healthcare providers with the infrastructure needed to expand clinical education across all healthcare disciplines. With partnerships spanning 100+ allopathic (MD), osteopathic (DO), nursing (NP and pre-licensure), PA, and allied health degree programs at 650+ healthcare institutions nationwide and internationally, AMO is solving the healthcare training shortage by enabling quality clinical education at scale.

Since expanding to domestic B2B solutions in 2020, we've secured 75+ partnerships with U.S. academic institutions and placed students in nearly 6,000 clinical rotations. Our proprietary SaaS platform and comprehensive service solutions help schools expand enrollment, open new clinical campuses, and prepare for accreditation visits.

At AMOpportunities, we're guided by a clear set of values that shape how we show up for each other and for those we serve, every day.

  • Trust: Trust the process. Trust one another.
  • Impact: Local focus, global impact. Solutions today for tomorrow.
  • Be a global citizen: Collaborative mindset. Embrace our differences. Work better together.
  • Quality: High quality service. Delighting those we serve.
  • Adapt with Agility: Embrace change. Move fast, stay flexible.
  • Rooted in Relationships: Strong partnerships. Support and celebrate each other. Grow together.

Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. AMOpportunities encourages you to apply even if you do not meet all listed qualifications. We look forward to your application. 

About the position:

The Clinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter is responsible for building and expanding AMO's national clinical network by identifying, engaging, and developing partnerships with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and healthcare organizations that support clinical education programs.

This is a highly results-driven role designed for professionals who already possess a strong foundation in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, or credentialing and are motivated to make an immediate impact. While AMO provides training on our systems, processes, and platform, successful candidates bring industry knowledge, professional judgment, and the confidence to quickly operate with a high level of independence. This role is remote, but theClinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter is expected to collaborate with teammatesvirtually ona regular basis to ensure team goals are met and recruited leads successfully transition into active clinical training sites and preceptor partnerships. The company alsomaintainsan office in Chicago that theRecruiter mayutilizeon an as-needed basis.

The Clinical Education – Preceptor Network Recruiter owns a strategic recruitment pipeline from initial outreach through onboarding readiness, balancing relationship-building with measurable business outcomes. Success in this role is driven by thoughtful execution—not simply outreach volume. High performers know how to prioritize opportunities, build trusted relationships, and consistently convert conversations into long-term clinical partnerships that support AMO's continued growth.

This position is best suited for professionals who thrive in an environment built on ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Individuals who enjoy solving problems, thinking strategically, and delivering measurable results will excel in this role.

 

While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, or Texas.

Essential Functions:

  • Build and expand AMO's clinical network by identifying, engaging, and recruiting physicians, PAs, NPs, and clinical training sites through strategic outreach utilizing email, phone, video, social media, and other communication channels
  • Own a high-volume recruitment pipeline from prospecting through onboarding readiness, prioritizing opportunities effectively while consistently meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly performance expectations
  • Leverage HubSpot and other tech tools to build, prioritize, and manage a strategic outreach pipeline while maintaining accurate documentation, reporting pipeline health, and using data to drive recruitment strategy
  • Apply working knowledge of provider types (MD, DO, PA, NP), clinical specialties, and credentialing requirements—including licensure, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related verification processes—to efficiently qualify prospective partners
  • Educate physicians, advanced practice providers, and healthcare organizations on the value of partnering with AMO to support the next generation of healthcare professionals
  • Guide prospective partners from initial outreach through onboarding readiness while following documented SOPs, maintaining exceptional attention to detail, and exercising sound judgment to resolve issues independently
  • Negotiate educational stipends, collect required contractual and credentialing documentation, and ensure complete, accurate handoffs to internal teams
  • Collaborate closely with Partnerships, Operations, and cross-functional teams to meet school partner needs and placement timelines
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with both external partners and internal stakeholders, leveraging professional networks such as LinkedIn, while ensuring timely follow-up and exceptional customer experience
  • Identify opportunities to improve recruitment strategies, outreach effectiveness, and internal processes while maintaining consistency with established workflows
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills, Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in clinical education, healthcare recruitment, provider relations, clinical coordination, credentialing, or a related healthcare field strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding either KPIs, quotas, or performance metrics in a goal-oriented environment, or deadlines in a clinical education environment
  • Experience working with physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and/or healthcare organizations preferred
  • Strong understanding of provider credentialing processes, including licensure verification, board certification, Nursys, NCCPA, and related healthcare documentation
  • Experience managing CRM-based recruitment or business development pipelines; HubSpot experience strongly preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence healthcare professionals, navigate objections, and build long-term professional relationships. Comfortable with utilizing professional networks and social presence (LinkedIn) to generate opportunities
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and consistently execute documented processes while exercising sound judgment and independent decision-making
  • Exceptional organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing initiatives, adapt to changing placement needs, and maintain urgency without sacrificing accuracy
  • High level of professionalism, accountability, and ownership with a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, growth-oriented environment where individual performance directly contributes to team success

What You Gain:

  • Competitive base salary of $65,000 to $75,000 annually, and bonus structure tied to the achievement of KPIs and revenue goals.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Program: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k, Tax Exempt Student Loan Repayment, and Commuter Benefits
  • A mission-driven work environment committed to a spirit of support, growth, and achievement
  • Performance-based career growth opportunities
  • A front-row seat for the exponential growth of a booming education tech company
  • Work/life balance

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are deeply committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees, and to providing our employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strictly prohibit discrimination and harassment based on disability, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy status (including childbirth and related states), sexual orientation, race, color, social or ethnic origin, religion, age, HIV status, past/present military service, or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Department Overview

Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for execution of change programs. We rely on our team's expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.

Overview of the Role

Our Business Strategy Directors sit within Experience Services, driving complex, transformational strategy engagements as senior individual contributors and subject-matter authorities. Partnering with C-level customers, they craft innovative, industry-specific strategies that clearly define the vision, metrics, and roadmap to achieve desired business outcomes.

Business Strategy Directors work closely with our key enterprise customers, partners, and technical delivery leaders to drive scale, speed to value, and a sustained landscape for future success. They bring deep expertise in enterprise business strategy, operating model design, and value realization — translating customer ambitions into actionable, multi-year programs.

We believe the best business strategists are those who obsess over the creation of customer and business value. They have a customer-centric and collaborative mentality, a willingness to commit to the customer, and the drive to break down barriers to ensure customer success.

Responsibilities

  • Provide business strategy subject matter expertise as it relates to Salesforce products and services during the sales and delivery cycles
  • Help position and sell large-enterprise consulting engagements to customers; work cross-functionally within Salesforce to define program scope, team, value narrative, and pitch
  • Conduct assessments and facilitate workshops to develop future-state operating models and business visions
  • Perform and distill customer, industry, and end-user research to identify key customer needs, expectations, and experience-led business opportunities
  • Identify enterprise business process and operations improvements to realize efficiencies and increase impact
  • Develop multi-year, strategic roadmaps that prioritize investments and support business objectives
  • Help business and technology leaders adopt new digital operating models, governance strategies, and approaches
  • Uncover future sales opportunities to drive ongoing customer value
  • Independently drive engagement strategy and quality as the strategy resource on an account, partnering with (not managing) delivery, sales, and architecture leads
  • Develop strategic use cases to project the value of strategy, case for change, and organizational implications
  • Cultivate solution and organizational adoption, driving strategy evolution to deliver value through quicker delivery cycles
  • Build Business Strategy competency within Experience Services by codifying methodologies, mentoring peers, and elevating practice-wide capability — without formal management accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience consulting in enterprise-level technology transformation programs, ideally at Fortune 500 companies, with demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor on high-stakes, C-level engagements
  • Deep expertise in Consumer Goods Retail Execution (REX) within CG enterprises, consultancies, or software vendors. Experience unifying physical in-store execution with online/digital channels into a cohesive Omni Channel strategy is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce's Consumer Goods Cloud application
  • Thought leadership across Cycle Planning & Territory Design, Retail Execution Management, Store Audits, Order Capture & Management, Merchandising, Promotion/Rebate Management , global Route-to-Market models and execution strategies, including Direct Store Delivery (DSD), Van Sales, Distributor Management Systems (DMS) and emerging retail AI use cases (image recognition, AR/VR)
  • Go-to-market (GTM) support experience, including scoping, proposal development, RFP responses, and executive presentations
  • Experience in Business Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Product Management, Agile, Program Governance, Experience Design, Change Management, and/or Value Realization
  • Salesforce product knowledge and solution design experience required
  • Strong understanding of key business value drivers and success metrics typical of large-enterprise companies
  • Ability to develop industry POVs, including identifying market trends, responses, and solution offerings
  • Ability to analyze and synthesize information, working in situations where data may be absent or ambiguous and creative approaches are required
  • Comfortable pitching to C-suite executives, including strong objection-handling abilities
  • Thrives working cross-functionally, particularly with Sales, Engagement Leaders, Solution and Technical Architects, Experience Designers, and External Partners
  • Proven ability to lead through influence and expertise rather than formal authority — guiding cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct reporting lines.
  • Working knowledge of AI capabilities and how to responsibly apply them in a consulting context.
  • Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g., extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

QA Automation Engineer — Projetos para o setor financeiro

A OSF Digital está em busca de uma pessoa QA Automation Engineer para atuar em projetos de um cliente do segmento bancário, contribuindo para a qualidade, confiabilidade e segurança de aplicações que suportam funcionalidades críticas para os usuários e para o negócio.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental no desenvolvimento, na manutenção e na evolução de estratégias, frameworks e scripts de testes automatizados. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar a validação funcional e não funcional das aplicações, com atenção especial a fluxos financeiros, integrações, autenticação, autorização, processamento de transações, consistência de dados e continuidade dos serviços.

O objetivo principal será ampliar a cobertura de testes, identificar riscos antecipadamente, otimizar os processos de QA e contribuir para ciclos de entrega de software mais seguros, previsíveis e eficientes.

A pessoa ideal para essa oportunidade possui experiência sólida em automação de testes, conhecimento de metodologias e práticas de QA, familiaridade com pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas e capacidade de atuar em colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.

Responsabilidades
  • Projetar, desenvolver, manter e evoluir scripts, componentes e frameworks de testes automatizados.
  • Definir estratégias de automação considerando riscos, criticidade, frequência de execução, retorno do investimento e esforço de manutenção.
  • Implementar automação para diferentes tipos e níveis de testes, incluindo:
    • Testes funcionais;
    • Testes de regressão;
    • Testes de integração;
    • Testes de API e serviços;
    • Testes end-to-end;
    • Testes de performance, carga e estresse;
    • Testes de contrato, quando aplicável;
    • Testes de segurança em colaboração com as equipes especializadas;
    • Testes de compatibilidade e, quando aplicável, testes em aplicações mobile.
  • Validar funcionalidades críticas do negócio, como autenticação, autorização, controle de acesso, processamento de transações, limites, saldos, consistência de dados, notificações e integrações com sistemas internos e externos.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de produto, desenvolvimento, arquitetura, segurança e QA na identificação, análise e priorização de cenários de teste.
  • Avaliar riscos relacionados à qualidade, disponibilidade, integridade, confidencialidade e rastreabilidade das informações.
  • Utilizar as técnicas internas estabelecidas para estimar o esforço de automação, implementação, execução e manutenção das suítes de testes.
  • Integrar testes automatizados aos pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas — CI/CD.
  • Analisar resultados de testes, identificando falhas, padrões, tendências, instabilidades e possíveis problemas no ambiente de execução.
  • Investigar falhas de automação e distinguir problemas de aplicação, ambiente, dados, configuração ou instabilidade dos próprios testes.
  • Registrar, acompanhar e comunicar defeitos com informações claras, evidências e impacto para o negócio.
  • Elaborar relatórios sobre a execução dos testes, cobertura, resultados, riscos e defeitos identificados.
  • Trabalhar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir que os testes estejam alinhados aos requisitos funcionais, não funcionais e regulatórios aplicáveis ao projeto.
  • Manter e aprimorar o ambiente de automação, assegurando sua confiabilidade, escalabilidade, reutilização e facilidade de manutenção.
  • Garantir que os testes utilizem dados adequados e seguros, evitando a exposição indevida de informações sensíveis ou dados reais de clientes.
  • Contribuir para a definição e o acompanhamento de indicadores de qualidade, como cobertura de testes, taxa de aprovação, taxa de falhas, tempo de execução, reincidência de defeitos e estabilidade da suíte automatizada.
  • Acompanhar a evolução das ferramentas, técnicas e boas práticas de automação de testes.
  • Orientar e apoiar profissionais de QA manual na adoção e evolução de práticas de automação.
  • Compartilhar conhecimento por meio de documentação, demonstrações, revisões técnicas e apoio à equipe.
  • Seguir as boas práticas de engenharia de software, automação, segurança, privacidade e qualidade estabelecidas pela organização e pelo projeto.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de QA e da estratégia geral de qualidade.
  • Utilizar as ferramentas internas de colaboração e conhecimento, incluindo o AllAi, de acordo com as políticas da empresa, para consultar informações sobre ferramentas, tecnologias e métodos de teste necessários às atividades do dia a dia.

Requirements

Competências técnicas

Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Experiência comprovada como QA Automation Engineer, Test Automation Engineer ou em posição similar.
  • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de frameworks e suítes de testes automatizados.
  • Conhecimento de programação aplicado à automação de testes em pelo menos uma das seguintes linguagens:
    • Java;
    • Python;
    • C#;
  • Experiência com uma ou mais ferramentas ou frameworks de automação, como:
    • Selenium;
    • Appium;
    • JUnit;
    • TestNG;
  • Experiência com testes de aplicações web, APIs e integrações.
  • Experiência com ferramenta de gerenciamento de projetos na nuvem: Jira.
  • Conhecimento de diferentes tipos e níveis de testes de software.
  • Vivência com integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de Git e de práticas de versionamento de código.
  • Experiência na análise de resultados de testes e no reporte, acompanhamento e validação de defeitos.
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de automação, como:
    • Reutilização de componentes;
    • Separação entre dados, ações e validações;
    • Controle de massa de testes;
    • Tratamento de evidências;
    • Redução de testes instáveis;
    • Manutenção e escalabilidade da suíte.

Diferenciais
  • Experiência em projetos do setor financeiro, bancário, pagamentos ou outros ambientes altamente regulados.
  • Conhecimento de testes relacionados a:
    • Autenticação multifator;
    • Controle de acesso e autorização;
    • Transações financeiras;
    • Idempotência;
    • Conciliação;
    • Integridade e consistência de dados;
    • Auditoria e rastreabilidade;
    • Disponibilidade e recuperação de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de testes de segurança, incluindo validações relacionadas a autenticação, autorização, exposição de dados e vulnerabilidades comuns.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de testes de API, como Postman, REST Assured ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de bancos de dados e SQL para validação de dados.
  • Experiência com testes de performance utilizando ferramentas como JMeter, Gatling, k6 ou equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes cloud, microsserviços, mensageria e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Familiaridade com práticas de privacidade e proteção de dados, incluindo os princípios aplicáveis da LGPD.
  • Conhecimento de observabilidade, logs, métricas e rastreamento distribuído.

Competências comportamentais
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, especialmente em funcionalidades críticas e cenários de exceção.
  • Organização e capacidade de priorização com base em risco e impacto para o negócio.
  • Habilidade para desenvolver scripts de teste claros, objetivos, confiáveis e sustentáveis.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Capacidade de colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares e diferentes níveis de conhecimento técnico.
  • Proatividade, autonomia e responsabilidade na condução das atividades.
  • Orientação à qualidade, segurança e melhoria contínua.
  • Capacidade de questionar requisitos, identificar riscos e propor melhorias.
  • Disposição para compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o desenvolvimento de outros profissionais.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos, com mudanças de prioridade e múltiplas partes interessadas.

Experiência requerida
  • Experiência sólida e prática com automação de testes.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento, manutenção e evolução de frameworks e scripts automatizados.
  • Vivência com testes de aplicações web, APIs, integrações ou aplicações mobile.
  • Experiência com integração de testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Experiência na análise de resultados de testes, investigação de falhas e reporte de defeitos.
  • Experiência trabalhando em colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, produto, infraestrutura, segurança e QA.
  • Desejável experiência em projetos do setor bancário, financeiro ou de pagamentos.

Idiomas
  • Inglês intermediário — nível B1, com capacidade de leitura e compreensão de documentação técnica e comunicação em situações profissionais.

Benefits

Conheça os benefícios e programas da OSF!

Oferecemos um pacote completo pensado para apoiar seu bem-estar, impulsionar seu desenvolvimento e acelerar sua carreira.

Benefícios:
• Vale Refeição ou Alimentação

• Assistência Médica

• Assistência Odontológica

• Seguro de Vida

• Gym Pass

• Auxílio Home Office / Educação

E tem mais! Aqui você também conta com programas que impulsionam o seu crescimento:

• Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos

• Programa de Idiomas

• Programa de Indicação de Profissionais com bonificação

Mais do que benefícios, acreditamos em criar um ambiente onde as pessoas realmente possam florescer.

A OSF Digital orgulha-se de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais a todos, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas em todo o mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todos os indivíduos e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, nacionalidade, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em nenhuma das jurisdições em que atuamos.

Vem construir o futuro com a gente!
